title: Social Media & Content Assistant
description:
Important notes 



Pay can be negotiated up if work is amazing after 3 months 



You should have a computer for basic editing 



You should have graphic design skills . Canva and photoshop 





———



Undefined Marketing is looking for a highly organized, creative, and dependable Social Media & Content Assistant to support our agency and the clients we serve. We primarily work with construction companies, contractors, home-improvement businesses, and other local service brands.

This role combines social media management, content research, copywriting, graphic design, project coordination, and content-library organization. You will help take content from the idea stage through publishing, while keeping our team, files, and client deliverables organized.



Core Responsibilities



1. Social Media Posting & Platform Management

• Schedule and publish content on Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, Google Business Profile, and Yelp.

• Write platform-specific captions, titles, descriptions, hashtags, keywords, and calls to action.

• Upload YouTube videos and Shorts, including thumbnails, titles, descriptions, playlists, and tags when needed.

• Confirm that every post is published correctly, on time, and formatted properly for each platform.

• Maintain an organized content calendar for all clients, including upcoming, scheduled, and published posts.

• Keep a complete record of every posted video, graphic, carousel, and photo.



2. Weekly Content Research, Ideas & Scripts

• Research content ideas within each client’s niche and identify topics we can film every week.

• Find high-performing videos, trends, hooks, formats, and competitor examples that can be adapted for our clients.

• Create organized weekly lists of content ideas for upcoming shoots.

• Develop short-form scripts, opening hooks, talking points, interview questions, calls to action, and shooting-style recommendations.

• Organize reference videos and explain why each example is useful or likely to perform well.

• Research construction, real estate, home improvement, and other local-service industries as assigned.





3. Video Library & Raw Footage Organization

• Review our existing video library and identify footage that can be repurposed into new content.

• Go through raw footage, rename files, organize folders, and prepare clips for our video editors.

• Identify footage that can become Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, long-form videos, before-and-after posts, educational videos, or promotional content.

• Match raw footage with content ideas, scripts, hooks, and editing references.

• Create clear editing notes and content briefs so editors understand the goal, structure, and key message of each video.

• Maintain an accurate production tracker showing each video’s status from idea to publication.



Suggested production stages: Idea | Scripted | Filmed | Sent to Editor | In Revision | Approved | Scheduled | Published | Repurposed | Archived





4. Canva Graphic Design & Digital Resources

• Create professional, on-brand graphics for our agency and clients using Canva.

• Design Instagram carousels, educational posts, promotional graphics, testimonials, before-and-after posts, service graphics, holiday posts, Stories, and YouTube thumbnails.

• Create useful downloadable resources, including e-books, guides, checklists, lead magnets, and client educational materials.

• Follow each client’s brand guidelines, including logos, fonts, colors, photo style, and overall visual direction.

• Proofread all graphics and verify names, phone numbers, websites, pricing, and calls to action before approval.



5. Performance Tracking & Reporting

• Track the performance of posted videos, graphics, carousels, and photos.

• Monitor views, reach, engagement, watch time, retention, shares, saves, comments, follower growth, and leads when available.

• Identify the best-performing hooks, topics, formats, lengths, and editing styles.

• Maintain a library of winning posts that can be recreated, updated, or repurposed.

• Prepare organized weekly or monthly performance summaries and recommend what the team should create next.



6. Photo Editing Coordination & Team Support

• Coordinate with our photo editor to make sure client photos are assigned, edited, reviewed, and completed on time.

• Provide editors with the correct footage, photos, logos, brand assets, instructions, references, and deadlines.

• Review completed work for missing files, incorrect logos, spelling mistakes, formatting issues, or missed instructions.

• Follow up on revisions and help keep projects moving without unnecessary delays.

• Maintain organized client folders, content calendars, asset libraries, and project-management boards.



Qualifications

• Experience managing social media for a business, agency, creator, or client account.

• Strong written English, grammar, proofreading, and communication skills.

• Experience using Canva and creating polished, professional graphics.

• Working knowledge of Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, Yelp, and Google Business Profile.

• Strong online research skills and the ability to recognize strong hooks, trends, and content formats.

• Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.

• Experience using Google Drive, Dropbox, Google Sheets, or similar tools.

• Ability to manage multiple clients, assignments, and deadlines at the same time.

• Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and ask useful questions when needed.

• Reliable computer, stable internet connection, and consistent availability.

Preferred or Bonus Skills

• Experience with construction, real estate, home improvement, local service businesses, or marketing agencies.

• Basic video editing experience using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar software.

• YouTube SEO, thumbnail, title, and keyword experience.

• Copywriting experience for social media, websites, ads, or lead-generation campaigns.

• Experience creating e-books, guides, checklists, or downloadable lead magnets.

• Experience with Photoshop or other photo-design tools.

• Experience with ClickUp, Monday, Asana, Trello, or another project-management platform.

• Understanding of paid advertising, lead generation, analytics, or social media reporting.





What We Are Looking For



Creative



You actively look for new ideas, trends, angles, and ways to improve content.



Organized



You can manage large content libraries, trackers, deadlines, and multiple clients.



Proactive



You notice what needs to be done and move projects forward without constant supervision.



Detail-Oriented



You catch spelling errors, missing assets, incorrect information, and publishing mistakes.



Dependable



You communicate consistently, meet deadlines, and follow through on assignments.



Growth-Minded



You are interested in learning new industries and growing into a larger content-management role.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:

• A brief introduction about yourself.

• Your résumé.

• Examples of social media accounts you have managed.

• Three to five Canva graphics or carousels you have created.

• Any e-books, guides, checklists, or lead magnets you have designed.

• One example of a short-form video script with a strong opening hook.

• Your expected monthly salary or hourly rate.

• Your weekly availability and preferred working hours.

• A list of the software, social platforms, and project-management tools you have experience using.

Full
-time Mon-Friday 9am-5pm AEST

ABOUT BUILD UP FLOW

Build Up Flow (BUF) is an Australian growth agency working with trades, construction, and design businesses. Right now we're focused on the AU market. As we grow, we're expanding into the US and other English-speaking markets.

We're not a one-service vendor. We're an integrated growth partner running paid ads, recruitment, and systems for clients who care about pipeline, not impressions.

We move fast. We're direct. If you like fluff or hide behind reports, this isn't your seat.



THE ROLE

This is a rare seat. You'll own the full demand engine for a portfolio of BUF clients: Meta ads, Google Ads, SEO, and the websites the SEO lives on. Most of our clients need a proper foundation built (site, keywords, technical SEO, Search/PMax/Meta campaigns) then ongoing optimisation across all of it.

We want one sharp operator who can run paid social and paid search, build the site under it with AI, and treat the whole thing as one funnel instead of separate channels.

You'll use AI hard across everything: creative briefs, audience research, ad copy and hooks, keyword research, content briefs, on-page optimisation, schema, and full site builds (Lovable, v0, Bolt, Claude, GHL's AI builder, WordPress + AI, whatever fits). We don't want a traditional web developer. Your value is knowing what to build, wiring SEO into the structure, and making it look and convert like a pro did it, not writing custom code.

This is a part-time role starting at around 15-20 hours/week across our current client load. We add new clients regularly, and your hours, pay, and account load grow with us. We want someone who treats BUF like their own agency, not a side gig.



WAGE / SALARY

$10-20 USD/hour based on experience.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Paid: Build, launch, and manage Meta ad campaigns end-to-end (CBO, ABO, Advantage+, pick the right tool for the job)

Build and manage Google Ads campaigns (Search, Performance Max, Display, retargeting)

Run structured testing across creatives, hooks, audiences, and offers

Brief and iterate on ad creative (we have separate creative support, but you direct the brief)

Track lead quality, not just CPL



SEO and web:

Full-stack SEO: keyword research, on-page, technical, content briefs, internal linking, schema

Use AI to build and iterate on client websites fast, with SEO baked in from the structure up

Map keyword clusters to site architecture and content plans

Set up tracking properly (GA4, GTM, conversion tracking, call tracking)



Across both:

Use AI tools daily for real work, not novelty

Set up and run campaigns through GoHighLevel (pipelines, automations, reporting)

Document your process and updates in Notion (our whole knowledge base lives there)

Weekly reporting with a clear point of view on what's working, what's not, and what's next

Communicate directly with the BUF team via Slack / Loom / call



MUST-HAVES



3+ years actively managing Meta ad spend (don't apply if you've only "assisted")

3+ years managing Google Ads (Search + PMax minimum)

Strong SEO knowledge: technical, on-page, and content

Proven track record managing AU, US, or UK client accounts

Proven results in lead-gen campaigns, not e-commerce only

Proven ability to build professional websites using AI tools (show us sites you've shipped using Lovable, v0, Bolt, GHL, WordPress + AI, or similar)

Strong taste: you can spot AI-slop and produce output that looks like a designer built it

GoHighLevel: confident setting up sub-accounts, pipelines, automations, sites, funnels, and reporting. You can build it, not just use it

Notion: comfortable working inside it daily for SOPs, tracking, and documentation

AI tools: Claude (web + Projects), Claude Code, ChatGPT used daily for real work

Strong English written communication

Reliable internet + ability to overlap with Australian business hours (AEST)

You can read a dashboard and form an opinion, not just describe what you see



BONUS



Experience with trades, home services, solar, or construction clients

Experience writing direct-response ad copy

Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation experience

Familiar with n8n or other automation tools

Has built or contributed to a GHL snapshot/template



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "FULLSTACK" so we know you read this.



Send:

Your best paid result on each side (one Meta, one Google) with numbers: spend, CPL, conversion rate, ROAS where you have it

2-3 examples of ads you've run (screenshots or links)

A site you've built using AI tools, link it, tell us which tools you used

One ranking improvement you've driven (keyword, position movement, timeframe)

The AI tools you use weekly and one specific way you use them in your work

Your rate and weekly availability



Applications without the keyword get deleted.

title: Mobile Frontend Engineer — RoseJob
description:
About RoseJob



  RoseJob is job search that actually feels good. Upload your resume, and our matching engine (7-agent resume extraction over ~25K live jobs from 30+ sources) builds your profile — then you swipe through hand-picked roles, each card showing the skills you bring vs. what the job needs. Think "match, bloom, hire." We're early, the backend is real and shipping, and the mobile app is where the product comes alive.

  

  The role



  You'll be our mobile engineer — owning the RoseJob app end to end, from gesture physics to App Store release. This is a craft role: a swipe app lives or dies on feel, so we care as much about a buttery card animation and a delightful loading state (falling petals ? blooming bouquet) as we do about clean architecture. You'll work directly with the founder and the backend/matching team, and you'll have real ownership over how the product looks, moves, and ships.



What you'll build



  - The swipe deck — fluid card gestures (? like, ? pass, ? super-like) with 
ntum, snap-back, and stacking, built on Reanimated + Gesture Handler running on the UI thread at 60fps.

  - The resume-upload ? extraction ? profile-review ? deck flow (our hard invariant: no swiping without a resume), including the document picker, upload states, and the "petals while we think" extraction experience.

  - The match card itself — our killer feature — rendering skill-expression overlaps cleanly and legibly.

  - The saved "bouquet" (liked stack), job detail, and apply hand-off.

  - The whole release pipeline: EAS builds, TestFlight, App Store + Play submissions, OTA updates, and the unglamorous parts (signing, review rejections, staged rollouts).



  Our stack



  Expo · React Native · TypeScript · expo-router · Reanimated · Gesture Handler · Zustand — talking to a FastAPI backend. You don't need to have used every piece, but you should be at home in this world.



  You'll thrive here if you have



  - Shipped real React Native apps to both the App Store and Google Play — and owned the releases, not just the features. (Send us links; we'll open them on a device.)

  - Strong TypeScript + React fundamentals (hooks, state, render performance).

  - Real fluency with gestures and animations — Reanimated worklets, Gesture Handler, 60fps interactions. This role is unusually animation-heavy; show us something that moves.

  - Comfort with the platform realities: iOS vs. Android differences, permissions, push (APNs/FCM), deep links, and surviving App Store review.

  - Enough native depth (Swift/Kotlin) to write or debug a native module and read a crash stack trace when Expo can't cover it.

  - An eye for polish and UX craft — you sweat the empty states, haptics, and the 100ms that makes a swipe feel right.



  Nice to have



  - Consumer / B2C app experience (especially anything swipe-, feed-, or card-based).

  - EAS Build/Submit + OTA update experience.

  - Animation/motion-design sensibility (Lottie, custom transitions).

  - Accessibility (VoiceOver/TalkBack) and i18n.

  - Comfort being the first/only mobile hire — scoping, shipping, and owning quality without a big team around you.

title: Graphic + Motion Designer with Strong Illustration (Agency)

Social content: posts, carousels, stories, thumbnails, basic ad creatives



Short-form motion: Reels/TikToks/stories with text animation, simple motion graphics, light editing



Brand and marketing assets: decks, one-pagers, simple web visuals (hero/section graphics), event and conference materials (slides, signage, etc.)

Real illustration work (not just stock edits)

Photoshop and Illustrator (or similar)

Potential to increase if it’s a strong fit



Please share your hourly rate (and/or per-asset rates) when you apply



How to apply



Please send:



A short intro about you and your background



A portfolio link that includes:



1) At least 3 social posts/carousels you’ve designed



2) At least 2 motion or short-form video pieces for social



3) At least 2 illustration pieces that show your actual skill level



4) If possible, direct links or file names for:



5) One social carousel or ad you’re proud of



6) One motion piece for social



7) One deck slide, web visual, or event/conference piece



8) The tools you use (design + motion/editing)



9) Your hourly rate and your typical weekly availability (in hours)

title: Web Developer / Designer who actually uses AI tools (Claude Code etc.)
description:
I run a small digital agency in Australia (web dev, design, AI consulting). I'm looking for someone to join the team long-term, starting with a paid trial.

Here's the honest version of the role. I take a brief from the client, then hand it to you. You take it from there and build the app or site out using AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, that kind of thing), follow my process, then properly test it before it comes back to me. I'm not looking for someone who waits to be told every step. I want someone who can run with a brief and bring it home.

I also pick up graphic design work from time to time, so an eye for design genuinely matters here. I'm not after someone who can only follow instructions, I want someone who notices when something looks off and knows how to make it look good.

What you need to be genuinely good at:



AI coding tools, Claude Code especially. If you've never used it, this isn't the role for you. I want someone who already builds this way.

WordPress. Real, hands-on stuff (themes, plugins, page builders, fixing other people's messes). A chunk of my clients are on WordPress, so this isn't optional.

Full-stack development AND design sense. You can build it and make it look good. Most people are one or the other. I need both.

A real eye for design. Layout, spacing, typography, colour. You can look at a design and tell whether it works.

Graphic design tools. Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Figma, whatever you use. I get graphic design tasks too and I need someone who can handle them.

Testing your own work before handing it over. I shouldn't be the one finding the bugs.

Good written English and clear communication. We'll be working closely.



Nice to have:



React or modern frameworks

Experience working to a brand brief, not just inventing your own style

Comfortable working independently across a few projects



The setup:



Remote, working Philippine business hours (we're only 2 hours ahead in Australia, so it lines up well)

Starts as a paid trial (1 to 3 months) so we can both see if it's a fit

If it works, it becomes permanent and ongoing



To apply, do this or I'll skip you:

Start your message with the word "Emerald" so I know you actually read this. Then tell me:



A project you built using Claude Code or similar. What it was and what you did.

Your WordPress experience, with links if you've got them.

A portfolio or a few examples of your work, including any graphic design.



Thanks,

Jake

title: Amazon Market Place Brand Strategist
description:
You must have at least 5 years of relevant experience (working for a USA brand) to apply for this position.



The Amazon Brand Strategist will oversee brand positioning, product performance, and marketing strategy across Amazon marketplaces. This role requires a blend of analytical thinking, creative direction, and marketplace expertise to drive visibility, conversion, and profitability. The strategist will act as the brand guardian on Amazon—ensuring listings, imagery, pricing, and messaging reflect our brand identity while meeting performance targets.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

Brand & Product Strategy

• Develop and execute brand-specific growth strategies to increase sales and market share on Amazon.

• Analyze category trends, competitors, and consumer behavior to identify opportunities for new product launches or repositioning.

• Partner with design, photography, and content teams to ensure listings are optimized for both SEO and brand storytelling.

• Understanding of AI models and how to utilities them for meaningful growth

Listing Optimization & Content

• Oversee listing creation, A+ content, brand storefronts, and enhanced brand assets.

• Ensure all product pages align with brand voice, visual guidelines, and Amazon best practices.

• Continuously test and optimize titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend keywords for maximum visibility.

Advertising & Performance

• Collaborate with the PPC and DSP teams to align ad campaigns with brand and sales goals.

• Analyze ROI and ACOS performance, recommending adjustments to maximize profitability.

• Develop promotional calendars, seasonal campaigns, and brand-specific initiatives.

Analytics & Reporting

• Monitor KPIs such as sales velocity, conversion rate, return rate, and Buy Box share.

• Prepare detailed weekly and monthly brand performance reports, highlighting wins, risks, and opportunities.

• Use data to forecast demand and collaborate with inventory teams for replenishment planning.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with operations and logistics teams to ensure consistent stock levels and timely shipments.

• Partner with accounting for budget planning, pricing, and profitability analysis.

• Liaise with customer service to ensure brand consistency in post-purchase experience and review management.



Requirements:

-Proven experience as a Virtual Assistant or in a similar role, preferably within e-commerce or Amazon Seller Central.

- Strong understanding of Amazon's platform, including listing optimization, order management, and customer service.

- Experience in digital marketing and PPC campaigns.

- Familiarity with inventory management systems and logistics.

- Knowledge of SEO best practices for Amazon listings.

- Highly skilled in graphics, including building premium A+ graphics.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

- High Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and other relevant digital tools.

- Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to work independently and follow instructions accurately.

- Office hours – 8AM – 430PM Pacific Standard Time.

title: Customer Support Administrator - WFH Remote | Full-time | Growth Opportunity
description:
We are looking for a highly organised and customer-focused Customer Support Administrator to join our team.Working remotely, you will play a critical role in supporting learners, trainers, clients, and internal tea
mbers while ensuring the smooth administration and processing of our training services.This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys structured administration, thrives in systems and processes, communicates professionally, and takes pride in delivering exceptional customer service.



About Us



We provide training services to a diverse range of customers, including government agencies, utility providers, construction companies, private employers, job providers, and event organisers. With a strong reputation built over many years, our organisation continues to grow through our commitment to quality, customer service, and continuous improvement. As our business expands, we are looking for an experienced administrator who can help us maintain high standards while supporting our learners and trainers every step of the way.



About the Role



As our Customer Support Administrator, you will be responsible for providing outstanding customer support while managing a variety of administrative and operational tasks that contribute to the successful delivery of our training programs.You will be trusted to work independently, manage competing priorities, and ensure all tasks are completed accurately, professionally, and on time.



Key Responsibilities



Manage inbound customer enquiries via phone,
, and shared inboxes.

Provide professional and accurate information to learners, clients, trainers, and stakeholders.

Process course administration activities and post-course documentation.

Maintain accurate student, course, and business records including confidentiality.

Complete data entry and administration tasks with a high level of accuracy.

Prepare and assist with funding and claim submission processes.

Manage learner feedback administration and follow-up actions.

Coordinate training resources, facilities, assets, and supplies.

Monitor and action tasks through project and task management systems.

Assist with data processing and general administrative support.

What We're Looking For



Customer Service & Communication

- Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

- Minimum 2–3 years' experience in a customer service, administration, or support role.

- Confidence handling inbound phone enquiries and customer communications.

- Professional, friendly, and service-focused approach.

- Ability to communicate clearly, ask the right questions, and provide accurate information.



Administration & Attention to Detail

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

- Experience managing documentation, records, data entry, and administrative processes.

- Ability to follow established procedures and maintain organised systems and records.

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage repetitive processing tasks consistently and accurately.



Systems & Technology

- Experience using CRM platforms such as Go High Level, Salesforce, Zoho, ActiveCampaign, Ontraport, HubSpot, or similar systems.

- Strong Microsoft 365 skills including Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams, and SharePoint.

- Experience using project and task management platforms such as Asana, Trello, 
, ClickUp, or similar.

- Confidence in learning and navigating business systems, databases, and online platforms.

- Experience using Training Management Systems (TMS) or Learning Management Systems (LMS) is highly regarded.



Remote Work Capability

- Previous experience working successfully in a remote or work-from-home environment.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection suitable for video meetings and cloud-based systems.

- Dedicated home office setup with dual monitors and a professional workspace.

- Ability to work independently, stay organised, and remain productive without direct supervision.



Organisation & Accountability

- Reliable, dependable, and consistent in meeting commitments and deadlines.

- Strong personal accountability and ownership of responsibilities.

- Ability to manage confidential information professionally and appropriately.



What We Are Offering

- Remote work from home position

- A positive workplace culture, working with a motivated and dedicated team around you

title: Remote Survey Programmer — Voxco / JavaScript Specialist (Market Research)
description:
Remote Survey Programmer — Voxco / JavaScript Specialist (Market Research)

Employer: TKW Research Group (Australia / New Zealand)

Location: Remote — Philippines

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time equivalent (approx. 40 hrs/week)



The Package — What You’ll Receive



TKW Research Group is a long-standing Australian/New Zealand market research firm, and we’re looking for a Survey Programmer to join us on a long-term contract basis. This is a real partnership, not a transactional gig — and a chance to contribute to something genuinely new in market research. The package reflects that:



• Front-row seat on a voicebot R&D project — you’ll contribute directly to a survey voicebot we’re developing with a tier-1 AI platform partner. Real conversational-AI exposure on your CV.



• Base retainer: ?90,000 – ?140,000 PHP per month, commensurate with experience and voicebot project involvement, paid in arrears.



• 13th-month service bonus equivalent to one month’s base fee, paid every December.

• HMO allowance of up to ?50,000 per year, fully reimbursing premium private health cover for you and one dependent.

• Internet & equipment stipend of ?3,000 per month to support your home office setup.

• 10 days of paid leave per annum after 12 months of service, plus observed Australian public holidays without reduction to your base fee.



• Full training paid by TKW Research Group — structured onboarding plus ongoing platform training (Voxco and related tools) so you can perform at the highest level.



• Direct relationship with senior project managers in Australia/New Zealand — no middle layers, no agency markup.



About the Role



We’re looking for a Survey Programmer who can take complex questionnaires and turn them into clean, well-tested, production-ready survey scripts. You’ll own the scripting pipeline end-to-end: build, test, launch, deliver data.



Direct experience with Voxco is ideal, but we’re equally open to strong programmers from Forsta/Confirmit, Decipher, or Qualtrics who can pick up Voxco quickly — and we’ll fund the training to get you there. What matters more is that you can write real JavaScript (not just drag-and-drop survey builder logic) and that you sweat the details on QA.



The Voicebot Project — What Makes This Different



Alongside your core scripting work, you’ll contribute to something most survey programmers never get to touch: TKW Research Group is partnering with a tier-1 multinational AI platform provider to develop a survey voicebot — conversational AI that conducts genuine, natural-sounding interviews at scale.



Your role on the project: building the underlying survey logic, question structures, routing, and validation rules that the voicebot will run. You’re not expected to be an ML engineer — you’re the survey expert who makes sure the conversational layer asks the right questions in the right order and captures clean data on the other side.



This is genuine R&D work with commercial backing. You’ll be one of a handful of survey programmers globally with hands-on conversational-AI experience on your CV.



What You’ll Do

• Translate questionnaires (Word, PDF, client-supplied) into interactive online and CATI scripts.

• Build complex logic: skip patterns, routing, piping, randomisation, quota management, custom validations.

• Write JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3 to extend platform functionality where the out-of-the-box tools fall short.

• Test thoroughly — logic, edge cases, mobile rendering, accessibility — before anything goes live.

• Export and format data (SPSS, CSV, Excel) for the analysis team.



What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years programming surveys in a market research agency, fieldwork house, or specialised BPO.

• Strong JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 — you should be comfortable debugging in browser dev tools.

• Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise platform: Voxco, Forsta/Confirmit, Decipher, or Qualtrics.

• Bonus points for SPSS syntax, Python, SQL, or experience with conjoint/MaxDiff modules.

• Genuine interest in conversational AI — you don’t need ML experience, but you should be curious about how survey methodology and voice AI intersect.

• Reliable home office: high-spec PC, dual monitors preferred, stable internet plus a backup option.

• Strong written English — you’ll be communicating with project managers in Australia and New Zealand.



How to Apply



Send your CV plus a short note covering:

1. The platforms you’ve worked on.

2. The most complex script you’ve built.

3. Your earliest available start date.

4. A sentence or two on why the voicebot project interests you.

?

This is a senior, deeply hands-on role. You’ll have real autonomy over how the floor runs, but you’re also expected to roll up your sleeves — personally running shifts when needed and working directly with front-line interviewers, not just managing through layers. You’ll be accountable for hitting completion targets, maintaining quality, and keeping projects on budget.



The Hybrid Future — What Makes This Different



Every senior CATI manager knows what’s coming. Voicebots are going to reshape telephone interviewing within the next few years, and operations leaders fall into two camps: those who get sidelined by it, and those who lead the transition. We’re looking for the second kind.



TKW Research Group is partnering with a tier-1 multinational AI platform provider to develop a survey voicebot — conversational AI that can conduct natural-sounding interviews at scale. Your role in this isn’t theoretical: as the voicebot moves from pilot to production, you’ll be the operational lead running the blended human/voicebot floor. D
 which interviews go to human interviewers and which go to the voicebot. Managing quality across both channels. Calibrating the hybrid model to deliver better data than either could alone.



If you’ve been waiting for a CATI role where you get to shape what telephone research becomes — rather than manage its slow decline — this is it.



What You’ll Do



• Manage CATI fieldwork end-to-end: sample distribution, quota matrices, completion tracking.

• Personally run live shifts when required — this is not a desk-only role. You’ll be on the floor (remotely) directing interviewers in real time, especially during critical fieldwork windows and across time zones.

• Monitor dialler performance in real time — contact rates, call dispositions, interviewer yield — and make tactical calls to keep productivity up.

• Coordinate Shift Supervisors, QA staff, and a remote interviewer pool.

• Troubleshoot operational issues live and work directly with the survey programming team when scripts need adjustments.

• Maintain ISO 20252 / ESOMAR-aligned quality processes.

• Produce daily and weekly operational reporting for the COO.



What We’re Looking For



• 7+ years in CATI operations within a market research agency or fieldwork BPO, with 3+ years in a senior management role.

• Strong working knowledge of dialler logic, CATI platforms, and call centre KPIs.

• Genuinely good with front-line interviewers — you can motivate, coach, and direct base-level interviewers directly, not just manage through supervisors. The best candidates have come up through the floor and haven’t lost the common touch.

• Solid grasp of market research methodology: sampling, quotas, weighting basics, and QA standards (ISO 20252, ESOMAR).

• Forward-looking on AI in research — you don’t need technical AI experience, but you should see voicebots as an opportunity to lead, not a threat to manage around.

• Comfortable with flexible shift patterns to cover multi-timezone fieldwork (agreed in advance — not random).

• Home office with reliable power, dual internet connections, and a setup capable of running monitoring tools and video calls daily.

• Strong written and spoken English.



How to Apply



Send your CV plus a short note covering:

1. The largest CATI operation you’ve personally run (team size, markets, sample volumes).

2. The dialler platforms you know best.

3. Your shift flexibility.

4. Your view on how voicebots will reshape telephone interviewing — and where you see your role in that shift.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Data Engineering, Data Warehousing & Analytics)

Position Summary



The IT Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and modernizing the organization's data platform and reporting ecosystem. This role serves as the primary technical owner of data engineering initiatives, working closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and development teams to transform operational and third-party data into trusted, actionable business insights.



The position combines data engineering, data warehousing, reporting, and business partnership responsibilities. The successful candidate will help drive the organization's transition toward a modern, data-driven culture while supporting both current and future analytics initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines integrating internal and external data sources.

• Build scalable ETL/ELT processes and data quality controls.

• Maintain and enhance dimensional models, fact tables, and dimension tables.

• Create mapping tables and conformed dimensions for cross-system reporting.

• Develop and support Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets.

• Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver analytics solutions.

• Support migration from SQL Server-based warehousing to cloud-based platforms.

• Monitor and optimize reporting, query, and warehouse performance.

• Serve as a trusted advisor on data strategy and analytics initiatives.



Initial Priorities (First 6–12 Months)

• Learn business operations, products, inventory, and distribution processes.

• Integrate new third-party datasets into the data warehouse.

• Expand Power BI reporting and analytics capabilities.

• Improve data quality and standardization across systems.

• Develop a roadmap for cloud-based modernization and future data architecture.

Technical Environment

Current: SQL Server, Power BI, Star Schema Modeling, ETL Processes, Operational Systems.



Future: Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake, Cloud Data Platforms, Modern Data Warehousing Architectures, Advanced Analytics Solutions.

Success Measures

• Strong understanding of business operations and stakeholder needs.

• Successful integration of new data sources.

• Increased reporting adoption and business value.

• Improved data quality and trust in reporting.

• Progress toward modernization and cloud adoption.

• Establishment of scalable data engineering practices.

   (Databricks is a plus)



Overall Mission

Build and evolve the organization's data platform, integrate new data sources, improve analytics and reporting capabilities, and help transform the company into a data-driven organization through modern data engineering and business intelligence solutions.

title: Freelance Content Creator Watch Video & Photography
description:
About Second Hour

Second Hour is an independent Australian watch company founded in Melbourne by Peter and Akira Sargison. We design and manufacture strictly limited-edition mechanical watches using Swiss and Japanese movements, a proprietary hi-tech surface hardening treatment, and in-house design from concept to quality control.



We are not a big brand. We are not a retailer. We are a small, founder-led company that makes watches the way they should be made — without compromise, without trend-chasing, and without volume targets. Every piece ships globally via DHL Express fro
lbourne.



Our price range is $525–$1,325 AUD. Our buyers are watch enthusiasts who research carefully, value craft, and respond to authentic content over polished marketing. They know what a good wrist roll looks like. They notice bad light. They can spot a cheap prop.



This is a premium brand. Content quality directly reflects brand perception.

We are looking for a creator who treats every shot as if it represents a $1,000+ purchase decision — because it does.





The role

We are hiring a freelance video and photography content creator based in the Philippines. We will ship Second Hour watches to you. You film and photograph them. We use the content across Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram feed, and Meta ads.



Field Detail

Position Freelance Content Creator — Watch Video & Photography

Location Remote — Philippines (or South-East Asia)

Arrangement Per-piece rate based on quality and experience

Volume 10–20 pieces per month across video and photography

Watch shipping Second Hour ships watches to you in the Philippines. You are responsible for safe handling and return shipping (we cover cost).

Turnaround Agreed per batch — typically 5–7 business days per delivery

Formats required Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram feed stills, Meta ad creatives

Reports to Peter Sargison, Founder — via WhatsApp and



?

Content types required

You will produce a mix of video and stills across the following formats. Each type has specific technical and creative requirements. Read these carefully before applying.



VIDEO CONTENT



Wrist rolls

The cornerstone of watch content on Instagram and TikTok. The watch is on the wrist and the wrist rotates slowly toward camera, held in a specific light to maximise dial and case reflection. Requires smooth, controlled movement, correct angle, and a wrist that presents well on camera.

• Format: vertical 9:16 for Reels/TikTok, square 1:1 for feed

• Length: 5–15 seconds

• Key requirement: the movement must be smooth and deliberate — no jerk or shake

• Lighting: natural light preferred, softbox acceptable, ring light not acceptable



Handling and detail sequences

Close-up handling of the watch — picking it up, placing it down, clasp operation, crown manipulation, rotating the case to show the caseback. These are the shots that communicate finishing quality and scale.

• Macro or near-macro focus on dial texture, indices, hands, and bezel

• Caseback perlage (decorative finishing) must be captured on applicable models

• Slow motion at 60fps+ preferred for handling sequences

• Dark or neutral surface props only — no bright or branded backgrounds



Unboxings

The Second Hour unboxing experience is part of the product. The box, packaging, and presentation should be captured in a way that builds anticipation before the watch is revealed.

• Clean surface, minimal props, camera locked off or on stabiliser

• Hands should be well-presented — clean, no nail polish, no visible jewellery

• Shoot the full sequence from sealed box to watch on wrist

• Format: 9:16 vertical for Reels/TikTok, also provide a 1:1 edit of the reveal 
nt



Pocket shots

Watch is held loosely in the palm or between fingers — casual but considered. Used extensively as stop-scroll content on Instagram and for Meta ad thumbnails.

• Watch face visible and in focus

• Background: natural environments preferred (concrete, stone, wood, greenery) — not white studio

• Both static image and short video versions required



PHOTOGRAPHY CONTENT



Hero product stills

Clean, premium product photography for Instagram feed, website use, and Meta ad static creatives. These are the shots that appear alongside ad copy and need to communicate quality at a glance.

• Flat lay on dark surface (slate, black fabric, brushed metal)

• 3/4 angle and dial-on shot as standard deliverables for every watch

• Correct focus on the dial — depth of field should render the dial sharp and the background soft

• No filters. Colour grading in post is fine but must stay consistent with Second Hour’s dark, premium aesthetic



Lifestyle and environmental stills

Watch worn in natural environments. On the wrist during everyday activities — at a desk, with a coffee, hands on a steering wheel, outdoors. These are used for feed content and Meta prospecting ads.

• Natural light strongly preferred

• Environments should feel considered but not staged — authentic, not stock-photo

• The watch must remain the focal point in every shot

• Wrist size: ideally between 6.5–7.5 inches for correct proportions on our case sizes



?

Reference content — the standard we are aiming for

Before you apply, study these five Instagram accounts. They represent the content style, quality level, and attention to detail we are looking for. They represent the content style, quality level, and attention to detail we are looking for across different tiers and formats. We are not asking you to copy them — we are asking you to show that you understand what makes them work.



Account Why we reference 
 
/fratellowatches — 258K followers. ‘Real people. Honest opinions.’ Study how they handle lighting on dark dials, the pace of their wrist shots, and the way finishing detail is communicated without staging or props. This is the aesthetic register Second Hour content should sit 
 
/whatknotman — 295K followers. Independent microbrand watch content creator. Directly comparable to Second Hour’s tier and price point. Note the macro photography technique, strap and bracelet handling shots, and understated 
 
/watchstudies — 400K followers. Watch Studies by Verne Ho. Exceptionally precise macro photography and dial study content. One of the strongest examples of how to make finishing detail the subject of a frame. Study the light placement on textured dials and the stillness of every 
 
/time.with.tyler — A smaller personal collector account recommended by Second Hour directly. Study the handling style, natural light usage, and the way the watch is positioned in everyday environments without forced 
 
/andre.watches — 5K followers, 703 posts. Andrea is a dedicated watch photographer whose body of work demonstrates consistent quality across macro stills, flat lays, and wrist shots. Strong reference for still photography technique specifically.



Your application must include a link to your own Instagram, TikTok, or portfolio showing watch content you have produced.

Applications without demonstrated watch content will not be considered regardless of general photography or videography skills.



?

Technical requirements

Requirement Minimum standard

Camera iPhone 14 Pro or equivalent Android (or dedicated camera). Must be capable of macro/close-up focus and 4K or 60fps slow motion.

Lighting Ability to control natural light or access to a softbox / diffused light setup. Ring lights produce unacceptable reflections on watch glass and are not suitable for this work.

Stabilisation Tripod or stabiliser for locked-off shots. Smooth handheld technique for wrist rolls.

Editing Basic colour grading and trimming in CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or equivalent. Deliverables must be exported at correct resolutions for each platform.

Deliverable format Video: MP4, H.264, minimum 1080p. Stills: JPG minimum 3000px on the long edge, or RAW files on request.

File delivery Google Drive or WeTransfer per batch. Organised by content type.



?

Rates

This is a per-piece arrangement. Rate per piece is negotiated based on your portfolio quality, demonstrated watch content experience, and the complexity of the deliverable. We do not pay a flat monthly retainer at this stage.



Content type Rate range (USD) Notes

Wrist roll (edited, Reels-ready): $15 – $35 Rate reflects quality and edit finish

Handling / detail sequence: $12 – $28 Per edited sequence

Unboxing video (full, edited): $25 – $50 Includes reveal 
nt edit

Hero product still (3 angles): $10 – $25 Per watch, 3 deliverable images

Lifestyle still set (5 images): $20 – $40 Per set, same watch and session

Pocket shot (still + short video): $10 – $20 Per watch

Meta ad creative (static): $8 – $18 Optimised crop + no-text version



Higher rates are paid for higher quality work, consistently delivered on time.

We start conservatively and increase rates as we build trust and see your work perform. Creators who produce content that generates strong engagement and ad performance are rewarded accordingly.

Initial test batch: 3 pieces (your choice of type) at agreed entry rate. We review together before committing to ongoing volume.

About One Janitorial

One Janitorial is a commercial cleaning company operating across Canada with active US expansion. We manage roughly 700 clients and 180+ alliance partners through a 36-person fully remote team. We're scaling toward $11–12M in revenue in 2027.

We don't clean buildings ourselves. We sell commercial cleaning contracts to businesses — medical clinics, offices, retail, warehouses, restaurants — and match them to local cleaning alliances who do the work. Sales puts the contracts on the board. You keep those clients happy, supported, and with us for years.

We live by one rule: over promise, over deliver. When a client has a problem, how fast and how well you respond is what keeps them. That's your job.



The Role

You are the first point of contact when a client has an issue. You take inbound complaints and questions, you own the problem until it's solved, and you coordinate with our cleaning alliances to make sure the fix actually happens. You report directly to the Client Services Manager.

You are the voice of One Janitorial to hundreds of clients. When something goes wrong, you're the person who makes it right — calmly, quickly, and completely.

This is a role for someone who genuinely likes helping people, stays calm under pressure, and follows through until the loop is closed.



What You'll Actually Do

You'll field inbound calls,
s, and tickets from clients. You will:

, and in a ticketing system all day

About Gannon Outdoor Advertising:

Gannon Outdoor Advertising is a dynamic and growing independent company specializing in the location and permitting of billboard development sites in the Texas area. With over a decade of experience in the billboard industry, and the last 5 years operating independently, Gannon Outdoor Advertising is poised for significant growth this year with several exciting development projects underway. Hours:

8 hour shifts

Monday to Friday 8am-4pm CST

Benefits:

The position offers a monthly salary ranging from 35,000 to 45,000 PHP (equivalent to 600 to 800 USD), commensurate with experience. Additionally, employees are entitled to paid vacation and holidays.

Responsibilities:

Administrative Support & Scheduling:

Proactively oversee Richard Gannon's family and professional calendars, ensuring recurring and personal commitments remain as fixed, non-negotiable blocks.

Contact landowners every morning to confirm all scheduled appointments and account for any last-minute changes.

 & Inbox Management:

 inbox by maintaining a structured hub with specific folders for "Action Needed" and "Review Required."

Adaptability and a willingness to learn new skills and take on new challenges.

Experience with permitting processes or the real estate/construction industry is a significant plus.

title: E-commerce Operations Manager (Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, eBay, TikTok)
description:
About FIT Strong & Healthy

FIT Strong & Healthy is a US-based health and lifestyle e-commerce brand selling premium borosilicate glass meal prep containers, bento boxes, and water bottles. Our customers are health-conscious, fitness-oriented people who care about quality, sustainability, and what goes into their bodies.



We sell across five platforms: Shopify, Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, and eBay. We are in active growth mode and building our first core team to help scale the business 10x.



Role Overview

The E-commerce Operations Manager owns the operational backbone of FIT Strong & Healthy. You will own three marketplace channels end-to-end (Amazon, Walmart, eBay) — handling operations, PPC execution, inventory, and listings. Catalog management and customer service extend across all five platforms: Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify, and TikTok Shop. You will also coordinate inventory and fulfillment with our 3PL and freight forwarders.



This role works alongside a separate Digital Marketing Manager. All marketing strategy, creative direction, storefront design, and campaign concepts come from the Digital Marketing Manager. Your focus is technical execution, catalog accuracy, marketplace operations, and keeping the operational engine running smoothly.



If you are someone who takes pride in clean operations, loves owning a process end-to-end, and wants to be a key part of building a growing brand — this role is for you.



What You’ll Own

Amazon Seller Central — Full Ownership

• Account management and seller health monitoring

• FBA shipment creation, labeling, and tracking

• AWD (Amazon Warehousing & Distribution) inventory coordination

• Amazon PPC campaign execution — bid optimization, keyword management, ACoS monitoring (strategy direction provided by Digital Marketing Manager)

• Helium 10 keyword research and organic ranking optimization

• A+ Content and Brand Store technical implementation (creative direction provided by Digital Marketing Manager)

• Case appeals to Amazon Seller Support

• Reimbursement claims for lost or damaged inventory using reimbursement management tools

• Negative feedback monitoring and removal

• Promo code and coupon configuration based on campaigns designed by Digital Marketing Manager



Walmart Marketplace — Full Ownership

• Walmart Seller Center account management

• Walmart Sponsored Products PPC execution (strategy direction from Digital Marketing Manager)

• Inventory sync, replenishment planning, and WFS (Walmart Fulfillment Services) coordination

• Listing data maintenance — titles, descriptions, attributes, images

• Review and rating monitoring

• Promotional configuration based on campaigns designed by Digital Marketing Manager



eBay — Full Ownership

• eBay Seller Hub listing creation and data maintenance

• Promoted Listings campaign execution (strategy direction from Digital Marketing Manager)

• Order management and shipping coordination

• Performance metrics and seller standards monitoring



Catalog Management — All 5 Platforms

Covers Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify, and TikTok Shop:

• Product listings — titles, descriptions, images, A+/Enhanced content

• SKU and variant management

• Pricing consistency and updates across all channels

• Inventory accuracy and stock level monitoring

• New product launch listings and product discontinuation



Customer Service — All 5 Platforms

Covers Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify, and TikTok Shop:

• Responding to customer messages,
s, and platform inboxes

• Returns and refunds processing

• Order issue resolution (missing, damaged, or incorrect orders)

• Maintaining on-brand tone and timely response SLAs

• Customer escalation handling



Inventory & 3PL Coordination

• Inventory forecasting across all channels

• Coordination with 3PL and freight forwarders

• Supplier communication (Alibaba, AliExpress, US-based suppliers)

• Stockout and overstock mitigation



Reporting & Strategy

• Weekly performance reporting (revenue, ACoS, BSR, inventory health, CSAT)

• Monthly strategy recommendations to grow each marketplace channel

• Other projects and tasks as assigned by the Founder



What We’re Looking For

Required

• 3+ years hands-on Amazon Seller Central operations — FBA, AWD, PPC management, case appeals, Helium 10, reimbursement management

• Experience with Walmart Marketplace (Seller Center, Sponsored Products, WFS) — strong preference

• Shopify product catalog management — uploading products, managing variants, updating inventory

• Strong written English communication — you will handle customer service across all platforms

• Experience coordinating with 3PL providers and freight forwarders

• Full-time, exclusive availability — this is a single-employer role; no freelancing or multi-client work on the side

• At least 7 hours daily overlap with US Central Time business hours (9 AM – 5 PM CST)



Strong Plus

• eBay Seller Hub experience (listings, Promoted Listings, order management)

• TikTok Shop catalog management and store operations

• Experience with inventory forecasting tools

• Familiarity with Amazon promotional tools and coupon management

• Experience managing Amazon AWD shipments

• Proficiency with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to streamline operational workflows, improve listing quality, and enhance customer service efficiency



Compensation & Schedule

• Base salary: Up to $1,000 USD/month

• Quarterly performance bonuses tied to marketplace revenue, inventory health, and Amazon ACoS targets

• Annual bonus tied to company-wide revenue goal across all 5 platforms

• Full-time, 40 hours/week — exclusive, single employer

• Must overlap at least 7 hours daily with 9 AM – 5 PM US Central Time

How to Apply

title: Transaction Coordinator
description:
We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company specializing in curative title, probate/heirship, distressed property acquisitions, and complex Florida real estate files. We are hiring an experienced Transaction Coordinator to help manage signed purchase agreements through document completion, notary coordination, attorney handoff, closing preparation, and deal-file tracking.





This role is best for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, steady under pressure, process-driven, and comfortable managing many moving parts without dropping follow-up items.





Role Overview



You will take over after a seller has signed a purchase agreement and help move the transaction toward completion. Many of our deals involve heirs, probate-related documents, title issues, mobile notaries, deed packages, affidavits, and attorney coordination.



This is not a sales role. It is a transaction management, document coordination, follow-up, and quality-control role.





Responsibilities



Coordinate post-contract files from signed purchase agreement through attorney/title handoff and closing readiness.



Schedule and manage mobile notaries for sellers and heirs.



Prepare, organize, track, and review document packages, including items such as:



Quitclaim Deeds

Joinders

Assignments of Interest

Affidavits of Heirs

Seller IDs

Probate/title-related supporting documents



Communicate with sellers, heirs, notaries, attorneys, internal tea
mbers, and vendors.



Create FedEx/shipping labels and monitor tracking.



Review scanbacks for completeness, missing signatures, missing initials, incorrect dates, missing IDs, or notary issues.



Maintain clean deal files inside our CRM/project management system.



Follow up consistently until every document, signature, ID, and required item is complete.



Track the status of multiple active files and provide clear daily updates.



Escalate issues quickly when a file is stuck, unclear, incomplete, or legally/title-sensitive.





Requirements



At least 2 years of prior Transaction Coordinator experience is required.



Prior experience with real estate transactions, title, closing coordination, probate, legal documents, mortgage files, or investor transactions is strongly preferred.



Must be comfortable working Central Time hours.



Must be available 25–30 hours per week.

title: COO/Management Residential Appraisal Report Writer
description:
We are a successful residential appraisal firm located in the Bay Area, California. We employ over 10 on the team and are looking for a very senior level experienced residential appraisal report writer to lead our team.



The team includes 3 Bay Area appraisers and 8 employees in the Philippines. We are rapidly growing and are looking for someone with experience completing the entire residential appraisal report, including commentary, who ideally has experience with managing and leading other appraisal report writers. Your role will effectively be acting as chief operating officer of our company while also being directly involved in reports.



Your role and responsibilities include the following:

1. Ensuring every report is completed to our standards. Either directly or through the processes and procedures you develop, it will be your responsibility to ensure that each and every report created by our report writers is free from errors and submission-ready. While this will start by having you directly review each report written by our team before submission, we are in the process of also hiring quality assurance reviewers, who you will lead and manage.

2. Training and managing residential report writers. It will be your responsibility to ensure that all report writers on our tea
et the criteria and standards in place to ensure high quality reports.

3. Acting as the liaison between leadership and the report writing staff. If there is too much work for the team, you will be in charge of letting leadership know so that additional tea
mbers can be hired. Or if there are any other issues, you will be in charge of resolving them or bringing it to leadership's attention.

4. Acting as the closer. Ultimately, everything on the report writing side will fall under your responsibility. We are looking for someone who is proactive at solving problems without getting the leadership team involved, however we are of course readily available to help out when needed. In line with this, if the report writing team doesn't have capacity to complete a residential report, you are expected to directly help out and complete these reports while at the same time working towards a solution to address this issue (hiring more, building better processes for writing reports, involving AI, etc).



To be considered for this role, you must meet the following criteria:

1. You have extensive work history writing reports for a US residential appraiser. Ideally you have done this for California properties. You must have extensive experience completing the entire report, everything from data entry to sketch to adjustments, 1004MC, selecting comparables, and commentary. If you do not have this experience, we will be unable to consider you for this position.

2. Ideally you have existing management experience, managing other appraisal report writers.



We are flexible with your work hours and offer Philippine daytime shift hours for your convenience. We would like to start part time but then transition to full time, so ideally you are open to working full time exclusively with us if its a mutual fit.



To be considered for this position, you must do the following in your application message (failure to do all of the following will result in your application being ignored):

1. How many years have you worked for a US residential appraiser? What tasks did you perform for them?

2. How many hours does it take you to complete one report? What parts of the report do you complete?

3. Do you have experience writing commentary for the addendum, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, and creating the 1004MC? Please indicate which ones you have experience with, and how many years for each.

4. Please provide a sample of at least one appraisal report you have fully completed. You can redact any private information from the report. Please let me know what parts exactly you completed on this report(s).

5. Provide a publicly accessible link to your resume.

6. Are you open to starting part time and then transitioning to full time? Once working full time with us, will you be working exclusively with us without any other jobs? When is the earliest you can begin working with us?

7. What are your preferred working hours?

8. Do you have experience managing other residential appraisal report writers? If so, please discuss in detail your job responsibilities.

9. Do you have experience in reviewing other residential reports? If so, please discuss in detail your responsibilities.



Thank you, and I look forward to the opportunity to work together.

ABOUT THE EXPAT PLAYBOOK



The Expat Playbook is not a travel channel.

We are looking for a story-driven editor who views editing as a craft.

OUR EDITING PHILOSOPHY



Every edit serves the story.



Story comes before effects.



Meaning comes before trends.



We are not trying to create flashy videos.



We are trying to create videos that help viewers think, reflect, learn, and take action.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR

• Meme editing

• Excessive transitions

• Constant zoom effects

Our audience is mature and thoughtful.



We value clarity, emotion, and storytelling.

Your editing experience

Three examples of your work

Software you use

What is the difference between editing a story and simply editing a video?



To help us identify applicants who pay attention to detail, please include the phrase:

somewhere in your application.

title: Project Manager | Delivery Lead

As the Project Manager / Delivery Lead, you'll be the bridge between technology delivery and business strategy — helping shape how technology initiatives are planned, prioritised, governed, and delivered across the organisation.



In this role, you will drive Agile ways of working, optimise delivery processes, and enable high-performing teams to deliver quality outcomes efficiently and consistently. Delivery Planning & Execution

title: Credit Analyst – Australian Mortgage Broking
description:

As a Credit Analyst, you will play a critical role in helping brokers determine whether a client is finance-ready and identifying the most suitable lending solutions.



You will be responsible for conducting detailed financial assessments, analysing complex scenarios, and assisting brokers in structuring deals that meet lender policies and client objectives.

Deal Assessment & Structuring

Review client fact finds and supporting documentation.

Analyse PAYG, self-employed, company and trust structures.

Assess borrowing capacity and loan suitability.

Identify strengths, risks and potential issues within applications.

Recommend suitable lenders based on policy and servicing outcomes.

Assist brokers in structuring complex lending scenarios.

Serviceability & Credit Analysis

Complete lender servicing calculators accurately.

Assess income types including:

PAYG

Casual income

Overtime

Bonuses

Rental income

Self-employed income

Company and trust income

Calculate debt servicing ratios and borrowing capacity.

Review liabilities, commitments and living expenses.

Analyse credit reports and identify concerns.

Lender Policy Assessment

Research and compare lender policies.

Determine lender suitability for each application.

Identify policy exceptions and alternative lending options.

Provide clear recommendations to brokers.

Pre-Submission Review

Complete preliminary assessments.

Identify missing documents and compliance gaps.

Review supporting evidence before submission.

Ensure files are submission-ready.

Broker Support

Work directly with brokers to discuss scenarios.

Provide recommendations on deal structure.

Assist with lender selection.

Support application progression through to approval.

Essential Experience

Minimum 2 years' experience working within an Australian mortgage broking business.

Proven experience completing lender servicing calculators.

Strong understanding of Australian lending policies.

Experience assessing PAYG and self-employed applicants.

Ability to analyse financial statements, tax returns and business structures.

Experience with residential lending.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Highly Desirable



Experience using:



ApplyOnline

Mercury Nexus

Lender servicing calculators 



Knowledge of:



Residential lending

Investment lending

Refinancing

Debt consolidation

Asset finance

Commercial lending

What Success Looks Like



The successful candidate will be able to:



? Assess a scenario and determine borrowing capacity.



? Recommend suitable lenders based on policy and servicing.



? Identify risks before submission.



? Assist brokers in structuring complex deals.



? Reduce turnaround times and increase approval success rates.



? Operate with minimal supervision.



To Apply



Please provide:



Resume/CV.

Number of years working in Australian mortgage broking.

List of lenders you regularly assess.

Experience with servicing calculators.

Experience with self-employed lending.

Experience with commercial lending (if applicable).

Systems and CRM platforms used.

Availability (Full-Time or Part-Time).

Expected hourly rate.



Only candidates with demonstrated experience in Australian mortgage broking and credit analysis should apply

We're seeking a dedicated Credit Repair Specialist with hands-on experience in the credit repair industry to help clients improve their credit profiles and reach their financial goals.

About the Role

The Credit Repair Specialist analyzes client credit reports, identifies inaccurate and unverifiable information, and executes strategic dispute processes that lead to measurable results. This role combines technical credit knowledge with strong client communication, keeping clients informed and engaged throughout their credit repair journey.

Key Responsibilities



Analyze tri-bureau credit reports to identify inaccurate, outdated, or unverifiable information

title: Social Media Manager / Booking Agent for Online Music Project
description:
I’m looking for a remote VA to help build and manage an exciting new online Substack-based original music production project. The project is in the early stages so offers great opportunities for additional responsibilities and wage increases for top performance as we grow. 



You will collaborate with me to strategize and implement a weekly content calendar of music recording instructional videos, Substack lives, monthly concert livestreams, podcast interviews, and music-related articles and tutorials to drive three main revenue streams: 



• Substack paid subscriptions

• Virtual concert gigs at colleges, conferences, festivals, art house theaters and other global venues 

• Sponsorships/affiliate advertising from relevant partners



The ideal candidate will be excited about collaborating with me to strategize, coordinate, and leverage my large catalogue of original rock music and virtual multimedia concert-presentations into active marketing funnels supporting these and future revenue streams. 



==================================================

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

==================================================



• Content Calendar Management: Help me strategize, produce, and upload/distribute project assets.

• Re-purposing digital assets across relevant online platforms to drive brand awareness and bring people into my Substack ecosystem. 

• Lead Generation for Booking Virtual Gigs: Online research and cold
ing to find and nurture contacts at venues (colleges, conferences, festivals, community theaters, independent art house film centers, etc.) across the world suitable for my unique brand of virtual concert presentations. (I will provide training to teach you what these virtual concerts are, to aid you in your outreach.)

• Lead Generation to book me on podcasts for interviews/performances and find promising Substack creators for potential collaborations and crossposts.

• Research of and outreach to potential partners for sponsorships and affiliate relationships. 

• Ongoing strategy sessions: Help me track and assess current business operations and brainstorm modifications to maximize and expand revenue opportunities.



==================================================

CORE TRAITS I’M LOOKING FOR: 

==================================================



• Creativity, initiative, and strategic thinking

• Promptness, honesty, reliability

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Strong collaborative spirit to work closely with me building a new innovative online venture

• Love of music / creative arts a plus



==================================================

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS:

==================================================



• Familiarity with Substack a plus, but if not, an eagerness to dive deep into mastering that platform as that is where the majority of my content will live 

• Proficiency with other social media platforms and ability to assess platform viability for re-purposed content and to upload and manage content on those platforms

• Communicative: You’re not afraid to give ideas, voice opinions and feedback, and to ask the right questions when anything is unclear

• Willingness to occasionally be on camera as a vital project collaborator during livestreams and other possible recorded videos is a definite plus

• Reliable internet connection



==================================================

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING DAILY:

==================================================



Each day you will work on one or more of the responsibilities listed above in the service of building my Substack audience, researching and nurturing virtual gig contacts and opportunities, and researching and setting up podcast interviews and collaborations/partnerships. 



Most days Monday to Friday we’ll do a check-in over Zoom for roughly 30 - 60 minutes in which you’ll update me on progress and we’ll brainstorm and discuss your tasks for that day. These Zoom sessions will likely be longer in the beginning as I train you on my music, history, story, etc., and shorter down the road as you become more familiar with me and the project and are able to take full initiative. 



==================================================

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU: 

==================================================



• Get in at the ground level of a unique and innovative online original music venture

• A chance to help shape the direction of a creative project from the ground up with a large impact on its direction and evolution

• Long-term, stable remote work with the potential to expand scope and rate



==================================================

HOURS & COMPENSATION:

==================================================



• 4 hours a day, Monday - Friday (flexible, remote)

• $5/hour   



==================================================

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

==================================================



1. Make your subject line: Awesome Music Project VA – [Your Name]

2. Send a brief summary of your experience as a VA. Include type of client, industry, type of work done, and softwares used. If you don't have experience as a VA, please say so.

4. Describe your other current work commitments and preferred number of hours you have to dedicate to this job. 

5. Tell me your favorite rock artist. If you’re not into rock music, that’s fine; tell me your favorite music genre and favorite artist in that genre.



Rock on... because music matters.
