title: Ecom Video Editor For Meta & TikTok Ads
description:
About Us:

We are a dynamic and rapidly growing 7-figure women's jewelry brand powered by Shopify. We are passionate about great design that speaks for itself, drawing inspiration from everyday fashion and influencers, and genuinely caring about the products we create and the relationships we build. Our marketing is performance-driven, and high-converting video creative is central to our scaling strategy.



The Role:

We're seeking a skilled and agile E-commerce Response Video Editor (full time / 40 hours per week) who understands how to create video ads that don't just look good but convert. You will work in lockstep with our Creative Strategist, taking raw footage (UGC, potentially studio shots) and briefs to produce engaging, platform-optimized video ads primarily for Meta 
/Instagram) and TikTok. Your job is to execute rapidly, iterate effectively based on performance insights (provided by the strategist), and ensure the final output is engineered for maximum engagement and conversions. Forget long-form content; this is about short, punchy, direct-response video.



***** IMPORTANT ***** 

This is not a role for someone juggling multiple jobs, working for or running a freelancing agency, or managing several clients at once. We are looking for a dedicated full-time video editor who will ONLY WORK EXCLUSIVELY WITH US and be fully committed to our brand, team, and creative output.



Key Responsibilities:



• Edit High-Performing Video Ads: Transform raw footage and strategist briefs into compelling video ads optimized for Meta and TikTok feeds/stories/reels.



• Rapid Iteration: Quickly execute multiple variations of winning ad concepts provided by the Creative Strategist (testing different hooks, visuals, text overlays, CTAs, music). Understand that iteration based on data is key.



• Platform Optimization: Expertly edit for platform best practices – strong hooks within the first 3 seconds, fast pacing, engaging captions/text overlays, appropriate aspect ratios (9:16, 1:1, 4:5), safe zones, and effective sound design.



• Integrate Copy & CTAs: Seamlessly weave in primary text concepts, headlines, and clear calls-to-action as guided by the strategist.



• Collaborate Closely: Maintain clear, fast communication (Slack, etc.) with the Creative Strategist to receive feedback, discuss edits, and ensure alignment with performance goals.



• Asset Management: Organize and manage video files and project assets efficiently.



• Meet Deadlines: Deliver high-quality edits reliably and on schedule in a fast-paced environment.



Who We're Looking For:



• Proven Social Ad Editing Experience: Minimum 2+ experience specifically editing short-form video advertisements for performance marketing campaigns on Meta & TikTok. A portfolio showcasing direct-response style video ads is required.



• Technical Proficiency: Highly skilled in video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut is a major plus). Proficiency in basic motion graphics (e.g., After Effects for text overlays) is desirable.



• Platform Native: Deep understanding of what works visually on TikTok and Meta feeds/stories/reels – you know the trends, the hooks, the pacing, the sounds that grab attention immediately.



• Performance-Oriented Mindset: You understand the goal is conversion, not just aesthetics. You are receptive to feedback driven by ad metrics and can adapt edits accordingly. (Links to Strategist's "Data Mastery," "Creativity That Converts").



• Speed and Agility: Ability to work quickly, execute variations efficiently, and adapt to changing requirements without sacrificing quality. (Links to Strategist's "Adaptability & Agility").



• Collaborative Spirit: Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively and receive direction from a Creative Strategist. (Links to Strategist's "Collaboration is Key," "Clear Communication").



• Strong Work Ethic & Accountability: Reliable, proactive, meets deadlines, and takes ownership of edit quality – no babysitting needed. (Links to Strategist's "Work Ethic").



• Detail-Oriented: Ensures brand consistency, correct aspect ratios, and error-free text/graphics. Nothing sloppy makes the cut.



• Basic understanding of direct response marketing principles.



• Experience editing UGC content.



Compensation:

$2,000 monthly base salary, with the opportunity to earn monthly performance-based bonuses tied to creative contributions. Total monthly compensation can reach up to $4,000 based on performance.



***** HOW TO APPLY *****



In your proposal, you MUST include (give as much detail as possible):



1. Provide your Resume/CV and link to your portfolio showcasing E-CO
RCE VIDEO ADS for Meta/TikTok. Other type of ads will not be looked at or considered. 

2. Briefly describe your process for editing a typical 15-45 sec. video ad.

3. How do you handle feedback and rapid iteration requests from creative strategists?

4. List your primary editing software and mention your experience with CapCut.

5. What AI tools or software have you used to create video ads and which is your favorite? Provide as much detail as possible and share any previous AI work if any.



***** APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS *****



1. Applicants MUST use a minimum of 10 Apply Points for their application to be looked at and considered.

2. Applicants MUST CONFIRM they are willing to complete a practical editing exercise/test trial as part of the hiring process. This is not a paid trial but for the right candidate, this opportunity can lead directly to a long-term position with us.

title: TIMESTAMPING - Twitch VOD Chapters for IRL Streams (English)
description:
SCOPE OF WORK (GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION)

 

TIMESTAMPER needed for an English-speaking travel and lifestyle streamer. His videos are long: 4 to 8 hours each. He travels around Asia (China, Japan, Korea) and the US (Texas, LA, Vegas, and more), often hanging out with friends, and also films cars and race tracks.

 

Your outcome is to:

 

1. Watch each video and fill in a Google Sheet that breaks the video into segments.

 

Success for this project is a clean, complete segment sheet for every video. You will not edit. You will not write scripts. You only watch and fill in the sheet.

 

 

KEY BULLET POINTS

 

- Required: You understand spoken English very well, including fast talking and slang.

- Required: You can watch a 4 to 8 hour video and stay accurate the whole time.

- Required: You are comfortable working in Google Sheets.

- Required: Stable, fast internet to watch long videos online.

- Required: You can send the sheet within 24 hours of getting the link.

- Ideal: You already watch travel or "IRL" streamers, especially in Asia.

- Ideal: You know basic car and racing words (lap, hot lap, track day, drift).

- Ideal: You know East Asian city names so you spell places correctly.

 

 

OVERVIEW & DETAILS

 

The streamer walks around cities in Asia and the US, eats street food, hangs out with friends, meets people, and films driving and race-track sessions. A good segment sheet helps editors and viewers jump to the right 
nt.

 

Good fit: Careful, patient watchers who label clearly and consistently.

 

Bad fit: People who rush, guess, or write vague labels.

 

 

EXAMPLES OF GOOD SEGMENTS

 

Each row in the sheet is one segment. Give it a clear name and a short description.

 

- Good name: Street food in Chengdu night market

- Bad: Food

- Bad: He eats something

 

Start a new segment when the activity or the location changes. One segment every 5 to 15 minutes on average.

 

 

TIMESTAMPING DETAILS

 

For each video, fill in the Google Sheet we give you. It looks like the sheets we use for our other channels. One row per segment, with these columns:

 

- Segment Name - A short, clear name (3 to 8 words).

- Start Time - When the segment starts (h:mm:ss).

- End Time - When the segment ends (h:mm:ss).

- Total Duration - End time minus start time.

- Description - 1 to 2 sentences on what happens in the segment.

 

 

PAY

 

Hourly, paid per finished video.

 

- Rate: $6/hr USD.

- Payment by PayPal, once the work is sent and approved.

- Rate agreed in writing before your first paid job. No payment before the work is done.

 

 

TO APPLY:

 

Send an
 to 
 with this exact subject line: [IRL Timestamps] Application - Your Name

 

INCLUDE:

 

- Your test: make a Google Sheet for this video, using the five columns above (Segment Name, Start Time, End Time, Total Duration, Description). Video: 
 . Share the sheet link set so we can view it. This is the most important part of your application.

- Tell us which travel or IRL streamers you watch, and any timestamping experience you have.

 

We will NOT consider:

 

- Applications with the wrong subject line or no test sheet.

- Any AI-written submissions.

 

Thank you!

mber who understands the current workflow

Location: Cupertino, CA (San Francisco Bay Area) – Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time



About AlphaX RE Capital

AlphaX RE Capital and its affiliated entities form a women-founded, integrated real estate firm based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Committed to creating innovative and sustainable housing solutions throughout California, our group manages an extensive and growing portfolio of assets and development projects. We are a leader in addressing the housing crisis by developing sustainable and affordable communities.

Taking a comprehensive approach, we oversee the complete real estate lifecycle from end to end. AlphaX emphasizes diversity, equity, and social impact, with initiatives such as the AlphaX Foundation and Small Builders Association empowering future leaders, women, and minorities in real estate. Our headquarters is located in Cupertino, CA, with additional offices in Southern California and Arizona.



Join our fast-growing architectural firm located in the vibrant city of Cupertino CA, backed by AlphaX RE Capital. Specializing in single-family homes, ADUs, SB9 projects, multi-family dwellings, and light industrial developments, we are a diverse team dedicated to excellence in every project. With an array of services covering the entire real estate spectrum, from land acquisition to property listing, our firm offers a unique environment for growth and learning.



Position Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented CAD Drafter to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating precise technical drawings and plans using computer-aided design (CAD) software. This role requires strong attention to detail, technical knowledge, and the ability to collaborate with engineers, architects, and project managers to bring designs to life.





Key Responsibilities

Develop and revise detailed technical drawings, blueprints, and schematics using CAD software.

Interpret design specifications, sketches, and notes to produce accurate plans.

Ensure drawings comply with industry standards, codes, and company guidelines.

Collaborate with engineers, architects, and other stakeholders to resolve design issues.

Maintain organized records of drawings, revisions, and project documentation.

Assist in preparing layouts, 3D models, and presentation materials when required.

Review and verify the accuracy of completed drawings before submission.





Qualifications

Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Drafting, Engineering Technology, Architecture, or related field.

Proficiency in CAD software (AutoCAD, Revit, SolidWorks, or similar).

Strong knowledge of drafting standards, construction methods, and technical terminology.

Ability to read and interpret engineering and architectural drawings.

Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

Experience in [industry-specific focus, e.g., mechanical, civil, electrical, or architectural drafting] preferred.





Preferred Skills

Familiarity with Building Information Modeling (BIM).

Experience with 3D visualization tools.

Knowledge of project management software.

Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple projects simultaneously.





Fully Remote

Schedule: 9:00 AM–5:30 PM PST, Monday–Friday (12:00 AM–8:30 AM PH Time)

title: Real Estate Media Photo Video Assistant
description:
Summary

Part-time or full-time virtual assistant with experience sending photos to clients, editing/fixing photos and videos of houses for real estate.



What a typical day may look like:

1) Submit photos to AutoHDR from Dropbox (our photographers upload at the end of the day Toronto time.

2) Make sure the photos look good and make any necessary adjustments to fix the photos either in Lightroom or within AutoHDR.

3) upload photos to Aryeo (platform to send media to real estate agents) and send to clients.

4) review videos from our editing team in Vietnam, provide feedback and revision to our Vietnam team if there are any glitches or fixes needing to be made.

5) upload final video to Aryeo to send to our clients (same listing portal as photos)

6) the above should take up most of the day, if there is extra time (especially in slower seasons), assist with our marketing and social media and other administrative tasks.



About the Company

We are a growing real estate media company based in Canada. We provide high-quality photography, videography, and marketing content for real estate agents. We need a reliable Media Editor & QC Virtual Assistant who can work while we sleep so listings are ready for our North American clients in the morning.



Photos Quality Assurance

We use AutoHDR for our photo editing. Sometimes the program makes mistakes and we need someone with a good eye and attention to detail to make those fixes before sending to the client.



Video Quality Assurance

We have a separate video editing vendor in Vietnam, you would review the videos and provide any feedback and fixes to our video editing team or be able to make simple fixes yourself.



Job Responsibilities

- Edit and enhance real estate photos (straightening slanted/horizontal lines, exposure, white balance, composition improvements, lens correction, etc.).

- Perform quality control on photos and ensure professional standards for composition, lighting, and overall appeal.

- Use AutoHDR and/or Lightroom for photo editing and fixes.

- Review video tours edited by our team in Vietnam using Final Cut Pro. Make minor fixes (color, cuts, stabilization, etc.) or provide clear revision notes to the editor if major changes are needed.

- Deliver completed media packages through Aryeo to clients.

- Maintain consistent brand standards and meet tight deadlines.



Requirements

- Proven experience editing real estate photos with a strong eye for composition, lighting, and fixing slanted/horizontal images.

- Experience delivering media through Aryeo.

- Comfortable using (or quick to learn) AutoHDR for photo enhancement.

- Proficient in Final Cut Pro for basic video fixes and QC.

- Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken).

- High-speed, stable internet connection with reliable power backup (no frequent outages) — this is critical as tasks are urgent and time-sensitive.

- Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.



Big advantage if you have:

• Previous experience working with North American or Canadian real estate media companies.

• Fast turnaround and strong attention to detail under deadline pressure.



What We Offer:

• Competitive hourly rate with long-term opportunity with a growing company.

• Clear training, SOPs, and Loom videos for our exact workflow.



Your resume/CV:

- experience related to this position

- Short video introduction (1–2 minutes) covering:

- Your experience with Aryeo, AutoHDR, Lightroom, and Final Cut Pro.

- Why you’re a good fit for real estate media delivery, quality assurance and editing.



Working during your day while it is our night time:

Your availability working during the day in your time zone. Our timezone is Toronto
 Time and it would be preferred that while it is our night that you are working with our video editing vendor in Vietnam and preparing photos to send to clients during the day in Philippine or similar time zone.

title: B2B Sales - BDM -Sales Rep
description:

Specialty Tire Sealant Company  •  Remote (US-based)  •  Full-time  •  CST preferred

IMMEDIATE OPENINGS — READY TO START WITHIN DAYS

We are actively interviewing and moving fast. Qualified candidates who submit a Loom video will be prioritized and moved to the front of the interview line.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re a lean, fast-moving operation running two complementary tire sealant product lines — one focused on heavy commercial and industrial customers, the other on consumer and light commercial applications. We’re looking for a high-energy, self-managed sales professional who can own the full sales cycle: prospecting and cold outreach, qualification, proposal, close, and ongoing account management. This isn’t a hand-off role — you’ll carry accounts from first call through reorder. Excellent written and spoken English is required. We serve customers across North America and have growing business interests in Australia, New Zealand, and Singapore.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

• Cold prospecting via phone,
, and CRM sequencing — you initiate conversations, not wait for inbound leads

• Qualifying accounts across fleet size, vehicle type, industry, and purchasing authority

• Routing prospects correctly between our commercial/industrial line (10–150 vehicles) and our light commercial line (1–25 vehicles, lawn care, ATV/UTV, powersports)

• Presenting product solutions, handling objections, and closing — consultative selling, not script-reading

• Processing orders and acting as a customer service point of contact post-close — you own the relationship

• Maintaining clean CRM records, call notes, and follow-up tasks

• Managing a defined territory with autonomy — consistent pipeline hygiene and reporting expected

• Supporting or serving as a regional point of contact for international accounts in Canada, Mexico, Australia, New Zealand, and Singapore



TERRITORY STRUCTURE

DOMESTIC

Southeast & Midwest / Central US

Fleet, agriculture, waste haulers

Construction, ag, fleet Northeast & West Coast US

Fleet, municipal, waste

Mining, construction, fleet



INTERNATIONAL

Americas

Canada — fleet, industrial, ag

Mexico — bilingual a strong plus Asia-Pacific

Australia — mining, fleet, ag

New Zealand — agriculture, fleet

Singapore — distribution, commercial



International sales experience is a strong plus — but if you’re simply based in or have existing business contacts in any of these markets, that alone is worth mentioning in your application.



REQUIREMENTS & PREFERENCES

Required

• Excellent spoken and written English — articulate, professional, no exceptions

• Available during CST business hours (8am–5pm CST core)

• 3+ years B2B sales experience, cold calling included

• Comfortable with CRM tools and order entry — not just sales, but account management

• Self-starter with reliable home office setup

• Proven track record of hitting quota or closing measurable deals Strongly Preferred

• Experience selling to fleet operators, construction, agriculture, waste haulers, or similar industrial buyers

• Bilingual English/Spanish for Mexico and Latin American accounts

• Existing contacts or prior business experience in Canada, Mexico, Australia, New Zealand, or Singapore

• Hands-on experience with CRM platforms for lead generation, pipeline management, and outreach sequencing

• Familiarity with CRM and accounting-integrated ops tools

• Background in industrial products, chemicals, or specialty consumables

• Experience selling value-added products — where the sale requires educating the buyer on ROI, cost savings, or operational impact rather than competing on price alone



COMPENSATION

Item Details

Base Salary Commensurate with experience — discussed during interview

Annual Bonus Performance-based, paid annually

Schedule Full-time, remote, CST hours preferred



Salary range and bonus structure discussed during interview. We’re open to hiring multiple reps for specific regions.



LOOM VIDEO — MOVE TO THE FRONT OF THE LINE

Candidates who include a Loom video are reviewed first and scheduled for interviews ahead of the general pool — no exceptions.



1 Introduce yourself (2–3 minutes)

Tell us who you are, what you sell, and why this role is a fit for you right now.

2 Show us you can sell on camera

Give us 60 seconds of a cold open — pretend we’re a fleet manager who just picked up the phone. We want to hear your voice, pace, and instincts.

3 Include your Loom link with your application

Submit the link alongside your resume and written note. Video submissions are reviewed and scheduled first.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume, a brief written note, and your Loom video link. In your note, cover:

1. Your strongest territory or industry vertical

2. A specific deal or account you’re proud of and why

3. Your experience with or existing contacts in any of our international markets



We are moving quickly — qualified applicants can expect to start within days of offer. Generic applications without a written note will not receive a response.

title: Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator
description:
Who is Bare?

Bare is the new way to funeral. We are a holistic end of life care provider, allowing our families to grieve in their own way, at their own pace, knowing their loved one is cared for by a team who truly understand their needs.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalized and affordable. In only five years, we’ve served more than 30,000 families, have become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (with awards in customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and have built a team of more than 100 people committed to changing the way Australians deal with end-of-life. And we’re just getting started.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator to manage operations for our Australian business. This multi-faceted role is critical to maintaining seamless daily logistics. You will be responsible for orchestrating domestic and corporate travel, managing supplier procurement in line with local compliance, and assisting with the maintenance and safety of our corporate fleet.

The ideal candidate understands the Australian vendor landscape, has experience managing corporate travel across ANZ, and brings a strong customer-service focus to supporting our local workforce.



Key Responsibilities

1. Travel Management (Approx. 40%)

Booking & Domestic Logistics: Coordinate extensive corporate travel bookings across Australia (interstate) including flights (Qantas, Virgin Australia, Jetstar), corporate accommodation, and car rentals.

Policy Compliance: Enforce the company’s travel and expense policy, ensuring cost-efficient booking habits and appropriate tier selections.



TMC & Platform Management: Act as the primary administrator for the corporate travel management platform (e.g., Corporate Traveller, FCM, or Serko) and handle corporate profile updates.



Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) & Expense Alignment: Support the Finance team by ensuring travel expenses are accurately categorized to assist with FBT reporting and tracking meals/entertainment allowances.



2. Procurement & Supplier Relations (Approx. 40%)

Local Sourcing: Raise purchase requisitions and manage the end-to-end purchase order (PO) process for Australian suppliers, covering office supplies, IT equipment, and operational materials.



Vendor Management: Onboard new vendors, track supplier performance, and maintain compliant records including valid Australian Business Numbers (ABNs) and GST status verification.



Payment Lifecycle Collaboration: Reconcile invoices against delivery receipts and POs, liaising closely with the Accounts Payable team to ensure adherence to agreed payment terms.



Modern Slavery Act Compliance: Assist the procurement team in verifying supplier compliance in alignment with corporate social responsibility guidelines and local Modern Slavery reporting frameworks.



3. Fleet Management Assistance (Approx. 20%)

Asset Tracking & Registration: Maintain an updated corporate fleet registry, ensuring all vehicle registrations (via relevant state bodies like VicRoads, Transport for NSW, TMR, etc.) and compulsory third-party (CTP) insurances are systematically renewed.



Maintenance & Safety: Coordinate scheduled logbook servicing, tyre replacements, and vehicle inspections to maintain fleet safety and uphold manufacturer warranties.



Fuel Cards & Linkt/E-Toll Management: Monitor corporate fuel card accounts (e.g., Ampol, BP, Shell) and toll account usage (e.g., Linkt), reporting on weekly or monthly variances.



I
 Management: Assist drivers with a
 reporting processes, insurance claims documentation, and coordinating roadside assistance when required.



Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an operations, procurement, or corporate travel coordination role within Australia. Previous exposure to vehicle fleet coordination or logistics is highly regarded.



Technical Systems: Proficiency with ERP/financial software (e.g., Xero, MYOB, SAP, NetSuite), expense management tools, and corporate travel software (e.g., Velocity, Concur).



Regulatory Understanding: Familiarity with Australian business operational requirements, including GST invoicing principles, state-based vehicle registration rules, and basic workplace safety requirements.



Communication & Negotiation: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to handling internal staff requests and local vendor negotiations.



Problem-Solving: Strong situational awareness with the ability to resolve rapid shifts in logistics, such as travel disruptions or freight delays.



What We Offer

Competitive salary package.

Collaborative team environment with hybrid working flexibility.

Clear pathways for professional growth and career progression across the operations and procurement functions.



Please include a link to your resume for review.

title: Senior Residential Appraisal Report Writer
description:
I run a residential appraisal firm located in the Bay Area, California, and am looking for an experienced residential appraisal writer to join the team. The team includes 3 Bay Area appraisers and 8 employees in the Philippines. We are rapidly growing and are looking for an experienced and senior level residential report writer to join our team.



Your role will be to do the following:

1. Complete the entire residential appraisal report after the appraiser has provided you with the inspection information and comparables. This includes all the commentary, adjustments, and all other parts of the report. We will provide training on how we specifically expect the commentary and adjustments based on our own personal preferences, however you are expected to already have this type of experience working for other appraisers.

2. Review the work of other report writers on our team, provide feedback, and help train newer report writers on our team. You are expected to act as the "last line of defense" of the report before it is sent to the appraiser for their final review before submission. As such, we expect you to be able to review the report, find any issues, correct these issues, and then send to the appraiser a near perfect report.



To be considered for this role, you must meet the following criteria:

1. You have worked for a US residential appraiser

2. You have experience performing data entry for residential properties in the US

3. You have experience creating the 1004MC, selecting comparables, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, making adjustments to the sales grid, and making commentary for the addendum.

4. Ideally, you have experience managing other appraisal report writers.



If you don't have experience in writing commentary or the addendum, or do not have experience with making adjustments on the sales grid, we would still like to hear from you as we have a different job that would fit your experience better.



We are flexible with your work hours and offer Philippine daytime shift hours for your convenience. We would like to start part time but then transition to full time, so ideally you are open to working full time exclusively with us if its a mutual fit.



To be considered for this position, you must do the following in your application message (failure to do all of the following will result in your application being ignored):

1. How many years have you worked for a US residential appraiser? What tasks did you perform for them?

2. How many hours does it take you to complete one report? What parts of the report do you complete?

3. Do you have experience writing commentary for the addendum, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, and creating the 1004MC? Please indicate which ones you have experience with, and how many years for each.

4. Please provide a sample of at least one appraisal report you have fully completed. You can redact any private information from the report. Please let me know what parts exactly you completed on this report(s).

5. Provide a publicly accessible link to your resume.

6. Are you open to starting part time and then transitioning to full time? Once working full time with us, will you be working exclusively with us without any other jobs? When is the earliest you can begin working with us?

7. What are your preferred working hours?

8. Do you have experience managing other residential appraisal report writers? If so, please discuss in detail your job responsibilities.



Thank you, and I look forward to the opportunity to work together.

title: Digital Content Director & Video Editor (Part-Time with Full-Time Scale Potential)
description:
*** PAYMENT SCHEDULE: This position is paid Bi-Monthly (twice per month) on a fixed, predictable corporate schedule. ***

*** IMPORTANT NOTE: While this position is listed as Part-Time (20 hours/week) to start, we are explicitly looking for a professional with the desire and capability to scale to a Full-Time, 40-hour salaried position within 30-60 days based on performance and channel scaling. ***



POSITION OVERVIEW:

The VEXXIA Lifestyle Entity is seeking a high-agency, long-term Digital Content Director & Video Editor to manage our multi-channel video pipeline. 



You will be handed a massive 5-year vault of premium, raw international and domestic travel footage, alongside fresh weekly lifestyle and business product recordings. Your single core focus is to turn raw assets into a high-retention storytelling machine. 





NOTE: Because this role involves handling highly confidential personal footage, behind-the-scenes assets from major network TV productions, and proprietary business materials, a signed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is a mandatory condition of employment.





CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. The YouTube Long-Form Show: Produce ONE premium, high-retention long-form episode per week from raw, unorganized, and unnamed footage dumps. You must be comfortable scrubbing raw files to piece together a dynamic narrative.



2. The Social Media Splitting: Extract and edit a MINIMUM of three high-velocity vertical short-form clips per week from the master episode to syndicate across shorts feeds.



3. The Product Engine: Edit THREE short vertical product-showcase clips per week for our 3D printing e-commerce division (raw footage of finished items provided, no long-form editing required).



4. Full Digital Distribution & SEO: Manage our Metricool dashboard to schedule and cross-post all assets. You are entirely responsible for top-tier SEO (titles, detailed metadata, tags, deep descriptions), writing captions, designing cover stills, and creating THREE variations of high-click-through thumbnails per long-form video for split testing.







REQUIRED CREATIVE EDITING STYLE:

We execute "High-Retention Cinematic Editing." You must study channels like HopeScope, Ryan Trahan, and Hangtime to fit our aesthetic workflow.

* The Pacing: Hyper-fast, changing visual scales, camera moves, or B-roll inserts every 3-5 seconds. However, you must leave tiny micro-pauses of breathing room for natural voice humor and dry delivery to shine. No robotic over-chopping.

* The Graphics & Text Style (High-Attention Revenue Engine): On-screen text, callouts, and info-graphics must be highly dynamic, energetic, and fully animated (pops, slides, and motion-tracking) to maximize viewer retention. We want a polished, high-end production look that feels expensive and drives massive engagement. You have total creative freedom to use high-contrast text, stylized graphics, neon highlights, and attention-grabbing pop-ups to punch up the comedic timing, highlight the story pacing, and keep eyes locked on the screen.

* The Hook & Frame: Every long-form video must open with 5-10 seconds of intense, high-stakes manufactured opening drama (the curiosity hook) before hitting a clean, gamified chapter structure using leaderboard tallies and progressive step counters on screen.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

If you are an independent problem solver who thrives under low micromanagement and can turn unorganized folders into master-level media properties, we want you.

description:
Summary

We are looking for a creative AI video creator/editor to help produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other social platforms.



This role involves turning provided scripts into complete AI-generated videos. You will create high-quality AI image scenes, turn those images into short video clips, and edit everything together into a polished final video using CapCut.



This is not just a basic editing role. You must be able to think creatively, understand the script, build strong visual scenes, and make each clip feel like part of a full story.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



Creating cinematic AI-generated images from scripts and prompts

Turning image scenes into short video clips using tools like VEO3 or similar

Building scenes that connect naturally from beginning to end

Editing all clips into a complete short-form video

Using CapCut to cut pauses, tighten pacing, add transitions, and polish the final edit

Making each image feel like a real video moment with action, motion, setting, and emotion

Following creative direction while also improving prompts and scene ideas

Producing at least 6 completed videos per day once trained



Important



We are not looking for someone who only copies prompts.



You must be able to:



Read a script and understand the story

Create image scenes based on the script

Turn those images into video scenes

Make each scene feel cinematic and natural

Connect multiple clips into one smooth sequence

Use creative judgment when prompts need improvement

Take feedback and make fast adjustments



Tools Used



Google Flow or similar AI image tools

VEO3 or similar image-to-video tools

CapCut for final editing

ElevenLabs / Captions.ai for voice or captions when needed

Gemini or similar tools for prompt support



Requirements



Experience with CapCut is required

Strong English communication

Strong attention to detail

Reliable internet connection

Understanding of TikTok, Reels, and short-form pacing

Creative thinking and visual storytelling ability

Ability to follow systems and improve over time

Open to feedback and fast revisions

Availability of 6–8 hours per day, 5–6 days per week

Long-term availability preferred



Preferred



Experience creating AI-generated video content

Experience with Google Flow, VEO3, Runway, Kling, Pika, or similar tools

Familiarity with TikTok-style hooks, pacing, and retention editing

Candidates in PH or similar time zones are preferred, but not required



Compensation



All payments will be handled through Upwork.



To Apply



Please include:



Examples of AI videos, short-form edits, or creative content you have made

A short explanation of how you would turn a script into a full video using this process:

script ? image scenes ? video clips ? final edit

Which AI tools you have experience with

Your availability per day and per week

Your experience level with CapCut



Qualified applicants may be asked to complete a small paid test task through Upwork.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for long-term team members who can grow with us, improve the system, and increase output over time. If you are creative, reliable, fast, and good at turning scripts into strong visual stories, this can become a consistent long-term role.

title: Virtual Assistant – Administrative Support for Commercial Glass Company
description:
About Our Company



We are a commercial glass, door service, and emergency board-up company based in Southern California since 2010.



Our company helps businesses keep their storefronts, doors, and glass safe, secure, functional, and professional-looking. We work with property managers, facilities managers, restaurants, retail stores, and corporate accounts that need fast, reliable service.



We value clear communication, attention to detail, honesty, safety, and excellent client care. Our goal is to make every client experience easy, professional, and trustworthy from the first call through the completed invoice.



About the Position



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help with day-to-day administrative tasks. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, accurate with data entry, comfortable using different software systems, and able to understand spoken and written English very well.



The position will begin with administrative support tasks, data entry, job tracking, and call review. Over time, the role may expand to include invoicing and additional office support.



Main Responsibilities



 1. Update Technician Travel Times



You will review technician travel information using the Bouncy app and enter corrected travel times into our Service Fusion software.



This helps us accurately track how much time technicians spend traveling to and from jobs, so attention to detail is very important.



Tasks may include:



* Reviewing technician driving/travel records in Bouncy

* Comparing travel times to job records

* Updating corrected travel time in Service Fusion

* Making sure job time records are accurate and complete

* Flagging anything that looks incorrect or confusing



2. Organize Before and After Photos



You will help review photos in CompanyCam and make sure the correct before and after pictures are connected to the correct jobs.



These photos may later be sent to clients with invoices, so they need to be accurate and organized.



Tasks may include:



* Reviewing CompanyCam job photos

* Identifying before and after pictures

* Making sure photos match the correct job

* Helping prepare photo information for client communication

* Noting any missing or unclear photos



3. Enter Invoice and Job Tracking Information



You will help enter invoice and service tracking information into Airtable. This helps our team monitor job progress, invoice status, service times, and client follow-up.



Tasks may include:



* Entering invoice information into Airtable

* Updating job status or tracking fields

* Recording service time information

* Checking that information matches Service Fusion or other systems

* Keeping records clean, consistent, and up to date



 4. Listen to Phone Call Reports



You will listen to recorded phone calls or phone reports and complete a form summarizing what happened on the call.



Strong English listening comprehension is required for this task.



Tasks may include:



* Listening carefully to phone recordings

* Understanding what the client or caller needed

* Identifying the purpose of the call

* Recording the outcome of the call

* Filling out a form with accurate notes

* Flagging calls that need follow-up from our office team



Examples of information you may need to capture:



* Who called

* What the call was about

* Whether the caller was a new or existing client

* What service was requested

* What action was taken

* Whether follow-up is needed

* Any important details the office team should know



5. General Administrative Support



You may also help with other admin tasks as needed. These may include organizing information, checking records, updating spreadsheets or databases, and helping the office team stay on top of daily work.



In the future, this position may also include helping prepare or send invoices, depending on performance and training.



Required Skills:



The ideal candidate must have:



* Excellent written English

* Strong spoken English comprehension

* Ability to understand phone calls and summarize them clearly

* Strong attention to detail

* Accurate data entry skills

* Ability to follow step-by-step instructions

* Good organization skills

* Reliability and consistency

* Comfortable learning new software systems

* Ability to ask questions when something is unclear



Software We Use



Experience with these systems is helpful but not required. We are willing to train the right person.



* Service Fusion

* Airtable

* CompanyCam

* Bouncy app

* Google Workspace

* Online forms and spreadsheets



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is careful, dependable, and takes pride in doing accurate work. This person should be able to work independently after training, follow instructions closely, and communicate clearly when they have questions. We want you to ask questions whenever you are unsure about any instruction we give. 



This role requires someone who understands that small details matter. Accurate travel times, correct job photos, complete invoice information, and clear call summaries all help our team serve clients better.



Important Qualities



We are especially looking for someone who is:



* Honest

* Detail-oriented

* Consistent

* Organized

* A good listener

* Easy to communicate with

* Willing to learn

* Comfortable with repetitive administrative tasks

* Able to handle confidential business information responsibly



How to Apply:



Please submit a short message outlining your experience with administrative support, data entry, call review, or virtual assistant work.



In the Subject line, please mention Code: RSZT to be considered for this position.



Please also include:



* Your experience with English phone call listening or transcription

* Any software you have used for admin or data entry work

* Your availability

* Your expected hourly rate

* A brief explanation of why you would be a good fit for this position

title: Executive GoHighLevel (GHL) Masterclass and Architecture Consultant
description:
We are looking for an elite, agency-level GoHighLevel (GHL) Architect and Paid Media Expert for a high-intensity, one-time strategic consulting project.



Instead of managing a team, you will be consulting directly with the agency’s leadership (CEO and COO). Your primary mission is to audit our core architecture, troubleshoot specific bottlenecked pipelines, and teach us your "insider secrets" so we can flawlessly manage, scale, and replicate our CRM builds moving forward.



We know top-tier talent comes at a premium, and we are fully prepared to pay your professional hourly rate for a true master of the platform.



---



The Mission & Scope of Work



This is a one-time, high-level consulting engagement (starting with roughly a 3-hour deep dive) focused on knowledge transfer and architectural diagnosis.



1. Advanced Architecture Audit & "Speed-to-Lead"



* Diagnose Lead Routing: Audit our current GHL filing architecture to discover exactly why leads aren't being reported to business owners fast enough, and show us how to fix it.

* Maximize Automation: Teach us how to implement missed high-conversion features, specifically elite "speed-to-lead" auto-texts, multi-channel follow-ups, and pre-qualifying lead structures.



2. Immediate Client-Specific Problem Solving



*Review and help us finalize a complex CRM build, correctly connect all social assets, and ensure our Meta Ads campaign is flawlessly integrated for launch.

* Troubleshoot our Meta Ads-to-GHL link to ensure the business owner receives lead data instantly.

* Advanced Data Visualization: Guide us on how to build sharp, visible client dashboards that pull and visualize data from Google Analytics and Google Search Console right alongside the GHL lead pipeline.



3. Framework for Scalability



The Blueprint: Teach us how to take our successful builds (like the lawyer CRM) and turn them into flawless, repeatable snapshots/templates that we can deploy identically for future service or medical clients.



---



Professional Qualifications



Elite GHL Mastery: Deep, insider knowledge of GHL architecture, snapshots, custom values, and advanced workflow triggers.

Niche Paid Media Expertise: Proven success running and integrating **Meta Ads** for service niches (experience with Personal Injury Lawyers is a massive plus).

The Ability to Teach: You aren't just a button-clicker; you can articulate *why* things work, explain complex workflows clearly, and pass your strategic knowledge onto agency executives.



---



Logistics & Structure



The Engagement: An intensive, one-time strategic consulting block (approx. 3 hours to start).

The Dynamic: You will be leading a session with the agency's COO (who will handle internal team execution moving forward) and the CEO.

Compensation: Open / Negotiable. We are looking for the best of the best and will match the hourly ask of a verified expert.



---



How to Apply



If you have the "real, studied, and tested" GHL expertise to take our agency's core architecture to the next level, please apply with your **requested hourly rate** and provide the following three items:



1. A Brief Intro: A very short, punchy summary of why you are a GHL expert.

2. A Relevant System You've Built: Describe a specific system or architecture you have built in GHL that directly resonates with what we are trying to build (e.g., advanced speed-to-lead, custom snapshots, or complex legal/service pipelines).

3. Your Portfolio: A link or documentation showing your past GHL builds, workflows, or dashboard setups.

title: TikTok Shop Lead Operator — $2,000 base + 25% uncapped profit share + year-end bonus (US LLC handled)
description:
This is a reposted job with revised compensation base & updated job title. 

Compensation at a glance

$2,000/month base, paid weekly via Wise (guaranteed floor)

25% of monthly Net Profit you personally generate, paid monthly, uncapped

15% override on the net production of any helpers we hire under you

10% year-end bonus on your annual personal Net Profit, paid every January 31



Real comp examples: $3,250/mo at $5K NP · $5,750/mo at $15K NP · $9,500/mo at $30K NP (full math + worked example in the Compensation section below)



This pays 2–3x what every comparable TikTok Shop role on OnlineJobs.ph offers. Keep reading to see why we can pay this and what we expect in return.



Essentially: you are building an entire TikTok Shop affiliate company from the ground up, with full financial backing and US LLC infrastructure provided by us. You bring the operational skill. We bring the capital, legal structure, and US-side resources.



About this role:

This is not a typical VA role. This is a lead operator role for someone who wants to build a real TikTok Shop affiliate business and earn like a senior tea
mber with real upside, not a flat-rate VA.



We're a US-based holding company launching a TikTok Shop affiliate operation. We provide the infrastructure — US LLC, EIN, US bank account, US-resident device/IP setup, US shipping addresses, working capital, and TikTok Shop seller verification. You build and run the operation. Product research, account warming, scripts, content production, posting, optimization, scaling. When the time is right, you propose new hires and we approve, fund, and onboard them under our LLC — and you earn a cut of what they produce.



You're the operator on the ground. The owner is hands-on with strategy, sets all base pay, approves all hires and fires, and owns final say on direction. You drive execution day-to-day with real autonomy inside that framework.



If you've ever run a successful TikTok Shop account and thought "I should be doing this with a real company behind me instead of $2/hr for an agency" — this is that opportunity, with the US LLC infrastructure already solved.



What success looks like

Month 1: Two TikTok Shop accounts warmed and posting 5+ videos/day each, with first commission revenue landed

Month 3: Three accounts running, 10+ videos/day total, $3,000+/month in net profit, your share clearing $750/month on top of base

Month 6: Established daily playbook, $15,000+/month in net profit, your share at $3,750/month on top of base (total ~$5,750/month)

Month 12: Scaled operation with 1–2 helpers you've trained, $25,000+/month net profit possible, your share clearing $6,000+/month plus base plus year-end bonus



Day-to-day responsibilities

You own day-to-day execution. That includes:



Product research — daily Kalodata / Shoplus / FastMoss workflow, your own filter stack, daily shortlist of 10 candidates, scoring top-performing videos for replicability



Sample sourcing — submit free sample requests and refundable sample purchases via TikTok Shop Creator Center to our US shipping addresses



Content production — generate 5 script variants per winning product, brief US-based on-camera recorders with structured shot lists, edit raw clips in CapCut



UGC creator hiring — you can brief and hire US-based on-camera talent through 
 (you brief them, they record, you edit and post — they don't need to keep the product). Budget for this comes out of operating expenses, approved by us.



Account operations — stagger-post 5–15 videos/day across 2–3 TikTok accounts (each on its own isolated device/IP), tag every video's affiliate product from Showcase before publishing, manage comment moderation and account hygiene



Pre-followed account acquisition — purchasing TikTok Shop-eligible accounts (5,000+ followers) is a legitimate part of the playbook. You'll source candidate accounts and submit them for our approval before purchase.



Drop-off & hook analytics — pull swipe-away / retention curves from TikTok analytics on every video, identify exactly where viewers leave, and use that data to rebuild hooks that hold attention past the first 3 seconds



Performance management — track 24-hour and 72-hour performance per video in shared Google Sheets, flag winners and losers per decision rules you build (with our sign-off)



Team training (when we hire) — when we approve a new hire, you train them, oversee their daily output, and earn a percentage of their net production on top of your base and your own profit share



Must-haves

1+ year hands-on TikTok Shop affiliate experience (you've personally operated accounts, not just managed someone else's)



Working knowledge of Kalodata, Shoplus, or FastMoss — you can name the filter stack you'd use to find a trending product without us prompting



Hook analytics fluency — you regularly look at where viewers swipe away from your videos and use that data to rebuild hooks. You can explain a specific time you fixed a low-retention video by studying the drop-off curve.



Exceptional written English (your scripts go to US viewers; your briefs go to US recorders)



Proven ability to ship volume — 5+ videos/day, every workday, without quality drop



Data-driven mindset — you read GMV growth, commission rate, and affiliate count signals fast and act on them



2+ years remote work experience with verifiable OnlineJobs.ph or Upwork references



Proficient in Slack, ClickUp or Notion, Google Sheets, CapCut, ChatGPT



4+ hour overlap with US Mountain Time



Reliable computer, fast internet, backup power



Comfortable with daily WhatsApp check-ins (morning plan + end-of-day recap) and a weekly direction call



Operator mindset — you treat this like real work that compounds, not a 9-to-5



Nice-to-haves

Prior experience under a US-LLC-backed structure operating US-market TikTok Shop accounts

Experience editing UGC-style product review videos

Experience hiring and briefing UGC creators (HourlyUGC, Upwork, Billo, etc.)

Experience buying and warming pre-followed TikTok accounts safely

Hands-on with Claude Code for scripting and automation tasks

Familiarity with US residential proxy / remote-desktop tooling (AnyDesk, RustDesk, BrightData)

Experience running multiple isolated social accounts without crossing fingerprints

Prior experience training and overseeing junior tea
mbers



Resources we provide

US LLC, EIN, US bank account, US shipping addresses, TikTok Shop seller verification

Working capital for samples, account purchases, and initial creator briefs

Tools budget: Kalodata, Shoplus or FastMoss, ChatGPT Plus, Claude Code, CapCut Pro, any other tool you make a case for

US-based UGC talent budget via HourlyUGC and similar platforms

Daily strategy access to the owner via WhatsApp, weekly direction call



Compensation

Base salary: $2,000/month ($11.55/hr × 40 hrs/week), paid weekly via Wise — your guaranteed floor



Personal profit share: 25% of monthly Net Profit you personally generate, paid monthly, uncapped, for as long as you are with the company



Net Profit definition: Gross affiliate commission revenue minus all operating costs, including your $2,000/month base salary, contractor pay (UGC creators, helpers), software subscriptions (Kalodata, CapCut, ChatGPT, Claude Code, etc.), sample purchases, account purchases, banking fees, and US LLC overhead. Your base is paid by the company as a normal expense — it does NOT come out of your 25% share.



Worked example (a $5,000 Net Profit month):



Gross affiliate commission revenue: $8,500

Less your base salary: ?$2,000

Less samples & account purchases: ?$500

Less software (Kalodata, CapCut, ChatGPT, Claude Code): ?$300

Less UGC creator contractor pay: ?$500

Less banking and LLC overhead: ?$200

= Net Profit: $5,000



Your 25% share: $1,250

Your total monthly comp: $2,000 base + $1,250 share = $3,250

Comp at higher Net Profit tiers (base always paid separately on top):

At $5,000/month Net Profit: $2,000 base + $1,250 share = $3,250/month total



At $15,000/month Net Profit: $2,000 base + $3,750 share = $5,750/month total



At $30,000/month Net Profit: $2,000 base + $7,500 share = $9,500/month total



Team override (when we hire helpers under you): When the company hires a helper under your direction, the helper's net production is split three ways:



Helper: 25% of their own net production (same share structure as yours)



You (operator override): 15% of the helper's net production, paid monthly alongside your personal profit share



Company: the remaining 60%



The 15% override equals 20% of the company's 75% cut — a meaningful piece of every helper you train and retain. The better you train them and the longer they stay productive, the larger your monthly override grows. Worked example: if a helper generates $5,000/month in net production, helper earns $1,250, you earn an additional $750 override on top of your own profit share, company keeps $3,000.



Year-end bonus: At fiscal year-end (December 31), you receive a bonus equal to 10% of the personal net profit you generated for the company during that fiscal year, paid by January 31.



Example: if your personal accounts generated $120,000 in net profit across the calendar year, your year-end bonus = $12,000, on top of all monthly profit shares already paid



This is designed to reward staying through the full year — someone who's accrued meaningful YTD profit has a real reason to finish the year strong rather than walk in November



Bonus applies only if you're with the company on December 31 of that year



Performance floor: After the first 3 months (during which we are getting the process / pipeline up and running):

Your personal monthly net profit generation must clear your monthly base pay ($2,000). If you fall below base for 3 consecutive months OR any 4 months within a rolling 6-month window, the role is terminated unless we judge that exceptional extenuating circumstances apply (which we will weigh case by case).



Why this beats every comparable listing:

Typical TikTok Shop VA on OnlineJobs.ph: $800–1,500/month flat, no profit share, no bonus

Senior pod operator with commission: $1,500–2,000/month + 5% personal sales (~$1,750/month at our target revenue)

Most "profit share" listings: $2,000 base + 10?ove a high margin threshold (~$2,250/month at our target revenue)

This role at $15K/month personal net profit: $5,750/month + 15% override on any helpers you train (~$750/mo per $5K-producing helper) + year-end bonus accruing toward $12K+ — total annualized comp ceiling far above any flat-rate or pod role on this platform



Transparency: Net Profit is calculated from a Google Sheet you'll have read access to, updated daily. Every line item is visible. No black box.



How we work together

Daily WhatsApp check-ins. Each morning you send a short message with your plan for the day. Each evening you send a recap of what you completed. Takes 5 minutes total. This is non-negotiable.



Weekly direction call. One scheduled call per week (30–45 min) to discuss overall progress, priorities, and any decisions that need our sign-off.



Final decisions rest with us — all hiring, firing, base pay, account purchases, and revenue policy decisions default to the owner. You propose, recommend, build the case. We approve.



You have real autonomy inside that framework on day-to-day execution: content choices, hook iterations, posting cadence, niche pivots, product picks, contractor briefs.



Long-term mindset — the owner's other business has retained OnlineJobs.ph hires for 2+ years. We invest in operators who invest in us.



How to apply

Follow all application instructions below carefully.



In your application message, answer every question below, numbered, in order:



List every TikTok Shop affiliate account you've personally operated. Include handle and approximate monthly revenue at peak.



What product research tool do you use? Walk us through your exact filter stack — the specific filters, in order, that you'd apply right now to find a trending product worth promoting this week.



Describe one specific time you looked at a TikTok video's swipe-away curve, identified where viewers were dropping off, and rebuilt the hook to fix it. What did the original hook say, what did the data show, and what did you change it to?



Pick one TikTok Shop product you'd promote this week. Tell us (a) the product, (b) why you'd promote it (data-backed), and (c) the exact 3-second hook you'd open with.



Describe one independent operational decision you've made on a TikTok Shop account — what was the call, what was the data behind it, what was the outcome?



What's your current US Mountain Time overlap availability?



What tools are you currently paying for out of your own pocket?



Do you currently operate any personal TikTok Shop accounts? (Yes/No — full disclosure required if yes)

title: Designer, Sky & Sol
description:
The Thing You're Actually Applying For

You're probably at an agency right now. Or maybe a corporate brand. Either way, here's

what your week looks like:

You design something sharp. You spend three meetings explaining it. Then a stakeholder

you've never met wants it "more fun." So you iterate. A PM wants it "conversion-focused"

instead. By the time it ships, the trend you were riding has moved on. And worst part? You're

not even sure if it worked because the analytics are a mess. You just know it was slower

than it should have been.

Or you're at a smaller brand that actually ships fast, but they're scared of AI. You show them

what Claude can do and they give you a speech about "authenticity" while you're literally

trying to accelerate your own thinking. So you use it anyway, quietly, and don't talk about it.

Here's what we're offering instead:

You work directly with our leaders on a brand that ships every single day. And I mean that

literally. We ship daily. Product updates,
s, ad creative, website tweaks. You'll design

three surfaces for us—our Shopify storefront, our
s, and our paid ads—and you'll do it

at velocity because we've built systems that let you do this.

And here's the thing: you won't be using AI as a side tool. You'll be using it as a real creative

partner. Your job is to know what Claude (and the other models) are actually good at, what

they suck at, and how to wire them into your workflow so you're shipping stronger work

faster. MCPs, connectors, custom workflows—the tools exist. You're the one who figures out

how to use them like a creative director would, not like someone hoping the model will do

your job for you.

What This Actually Looks Like, Day to Day

You'll design product pages that teach our customers something about their skin. You'll

create
 sequences that educate instead of manipulate. You'll produce static ads in

batch quantities because we're testing constantly and we move fast.

And you'll do this because:

? You have a portfolio that shows a real editorial eye and a coherent visual system

? You learned AI because it's actually the most interesting thing happening in design

right now (not because you had to)

? You're opinionated about which image gen models you reach for and why

? You can take a concept from prompt to shipped creative in a day

? You move without needing someone to check your work every five minutes

You are not someone who treats AI as a side tool or ships unedited model output. You're

someone who uses AI to think faster and push further.

Why We're Doing This

Sky & Sol exists because we think the skincare industry got skincare wrong. Every brand

sells fear or false promises. We sell biological compatibility. We use ingredients you can

actually pronounce. We teach instead of sell.

We're currently scaling across the US, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. We're

projecting significant growth this year. And the person we need is someone who understands

that design in a DTC brand isn't about being pretty—it's about being clear, fast, and true to

what you're actually building.

You're joining a founder who's been through this before (sold a previous company for seven

figures), who works remotely with a small trusted team, and who values ready-fire-aim

execution over endless alignment meetings.

The Setup

? Fully remote

? You'll work directly with me and our senior team

? You'll ship more in a month than you probably shipped in a quarter at your last place

? Unlimited PTO

? Competitive Base + Variable Pay

How to Actually Apply

Send your portfolio. But here's what we actually want to see:

Show us how you use AI in your real workflow. Not a prompt and an image. We want to see

your thinking. What problems did you solve with it? What models did you choose and why?

Did you wire anything together? Are you using it to prototype faster, or to think differently?

Write a quick note about one design decision you made where you had to choose between

what AI suggested and what your eye told you to do. What did you choose and why?

And if you want to tell us about a project where you shipped something good in an

unreasonably short amount of time, we're listening.

Send everything to

Admin Work — On the last working day of each week, dedicate time to organizing your files, notes, and research — keeping everything clean and easy to reference for the following week.

10 hours/day, 4 days a week, OR

8 hours/day, 5 days a week



Total: 40 hours per week

You must submit your work schedule upfront — what time you will start, what time your break will be, and what time you end. We expect you to stick to it. Consistency matters here.

 — you must have it and be active on it.

title: Account Manager
description:
About Rockenue

Rockenue is a technology-powered commercial management company for hotels. We handle revenue management, distribution, sales, and tech implementation for a growing portfolio of properties across Europe.



We're looking for someone with energy, hunger, and common sense — not necessarily a long CV.

You'll take ownership of a portfolio of hotel accounts, acting as the day-to-day point of contact for property partners. You'll produce reports, manage distribution channels, solve problems, and keep everything running smoothly. We'll teach you the hospitality side. What we can't teach is drive, initiative, and the ability to figure things out.

If you're the kind of person who Googles the answer before asking the question, who takes pride in getting things right, and who genuinely gets a buzz from being on top of everything — keep reading.



What You'll Be Doing



Managing a portfolio of hotel accounts end-to-end, acting as the main point of contact for property owners and managers

Producing and delivering regular performance reports to clients

Working inside OTA extranets (
, Expedia, etc.), channel managers, and property management systems daily

Monitoring rate parity, availability, and distribution health across all channels

Coordinating with the internal team on pricing updates, promotions, and new channel activations

Identifying revenue opportunities and flagging underperformance

Using AI tools, chatbots, and automation to streamline workflows and increase output

Learning and mastering new hospitality tech platforms quickly





Who You Are (This Matters More Than Your CV)



Relentless work ethic. You take ownership. You don't clock-watch. When something needs doing, you do it — properly and fast.

Common sense over credentials. You can walk into an unfamiliar situation, assess it logically, and figure out the right move without being hand-held.

Tech-obsessed, not tech-tolerant. You genuinely enjoy learning new systems. Complex dashboards and unfamiliar software excite you rather than intimidate you.

AI is already part of your workflow. You actively use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or similar to get more done. This isn't optional — it's central to how we work.

Proactive by nature. You spot problems before they're reported. You suggest improvements nobody asked for. You hate sitting idle.

Clear communicator. Excellent written and verbal English. You can explain something simply, flag an issue professionally, and keep a client confident.

Detail-oriented without losing the big picture. You catch the small errors but still understand why they matter commercially.



Hospitality experience is a plus but absolutely not required. If you've never touched a hotel extranet but you're sharp, motivated, and learn fast — we want to hear from you. We will train the right person.



Application Requirements

Your application must include a short video introduction (2–3 minutes) covering:



Who you are and a bit about your background

Why you'd be a great fit for Rockenue specifically

A brief example of how you use AI or automation tools in your current or recent work



Applications without a video will not be considered. This is the single most important part of your application — show us your energy and personality.



Compensation

Competitive monthly salary (paid in GBP/USD), commensurate with experience. Long-term position with real room to grow as the portfolio scales.

title: Full-Stack Content & Product Marketer (B2B & SaaS)
description:
Role Overview

We operate at the intersection of technical infrastructure and career technology. We run two parallel, high-growth tracks: CDOps Tech (an elite B2B infrastructure firm deploying interim DevOps/SRE squads to top-tier startups) and our upcoming Career Intelligence Platform (a developer-focused SaaS ecosystem).



We are looking for a hybrid, Full-Stack Marketer who lives at the intersection of technical copywriting, WordPress management, visual asset design, and product launch marketing. You will own our entire digital footprint, responsible for translating deeply technical concepts into beautiful, conversion-oriented case studies, social pipelines, and launch loops.



Key Responsibilities

1. B2B Case Studies & Collateral (CDOps Tech)

Interview the founding technical team to distill complex infrastructure achievements (e.g., Kubernetes migrations, downtime reduction, optimizing event-driven architectures) into highly polished, readable case studies and lead magnets.



Write authoritative, peer-to-peer content that commands immediate respect from senior technical decision-makers (CTOs, VPs of Engineering).



2. Product Marketing & Launch Strategy (Career Intelligence Platform)

Build and execute the comprehensive go-to-market (GTM) strategy for the upcoming SaaS platform launch.



Craft the messaging architecture, landing page copy, product walkthrough collateral, and onboarding
 sequences to drive user sign-ups and viral loops.



3. Website Management & Visual Design (WordPress & Figma)

Take complete ownership of our web properties. You will directly update, edit, and optimize our landing pages and publish new case studies within WordPress (using blocks or page builders) without requiring a developer.



Maintain on-page SEO best practices (meta-tags, URL structures, image optimization) using standard WordPress SEO tools.



Design crisp, minimalist visual graphics, presentation decks, and social media templates using Figma or Canva that match our clean, tech-focused brand identities.



4. Social Media & Campaign Management

Manage, write, and schedule a consistent publishing calendar across all official corporate handles (primarily LinkedIn and X/Twitter).



Repurpose long-form case studies and product updates into short-form, high-engagement text posts, threads, and visual carousels.



Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 3–5+ years of direct experience working as a Product Marketer, Content Lead, or Growth Marketer inside a B2B SaaS, developer-tool, or cloud-infrastructure startup environment.



The Tech Stack: Hands-on mastery of WordPress (including block editors/builders and basic plugin management), design software (Figma/Canva), social schedulers, and basic marketing automation/CRMs (HubSpot/Mailchimp).



Linguistic Technical Fluency: You must comfortably understand basic infrastructure terminology (e.g., DevOps, SRE, cloud scaling, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes) so your copy sounds authentic to engineering leaders, not generic.



Creative Multi-Tasker: A distinct portfolio showing a mix of both long-form written work (like case studies or whitepapers) and visual design work (like web layouts or social media assets).



The Style: Zero tolerance for generic corporate buzzwords or marketing fluff. You write with brevity, impact, and absolute clarity.



Note: Only for Philippines Candidates that do not require sponsorship

title: Senior Three.js / WebGL Developer (3D Patio & Roof Configurator)
description:
We're building a browser-based 3D patio and roof configurator that lets homeowners and builders design custom patios in real time and get instant pricing. Users pick a style (flat or gable roof), set dimensions, attach the patio to a house wall, choose materials, colours, gutters, infill panels and more, and the Three.js scene updates live. The app also generates spec sheets and PDF quotes from the configured design.



The 3D side is already functional. We have working flat and gable patio builders, dynamic rafter and beam generation, house attachment, measurement labels, and a server-side rendering path for preview images. Now we want someone strong in Three.js to help us take the 3D experience to the next level.



Current stack

Three.js (WebGL) for all 3D rendering. GLB/GLTF models for houses, roof components, gutters, fascia and more. Vanilla JS with a Babel build pipeline, Express/Node backend, EJS views, Stripe for payments and Firebase for auth.

What you'll work on



Improving geometry accuracy across dynamic rafters and beams, gutters, roof pitch and wall attachment. Parametric model generation that stays correct as dimensions change. GLB model integration, materials, lighting and visual polish. Performance optimisation and clean, maintainable scene code. Fixing edge case bugs in the flat and gable builders.

You should have



Solid hands-on Three.js experience on real projects, not just demos. A good grasp of 3D math including transforms, geometry, materials and lighting. Comfort working in a vanilla JS codebase with no heavy framework. Bonus points for parametric or CAD-style modelling, GLTF/GLB authoring, and performance tuning.



How to apply



Send a short intro, links to your Three.js work or portfolio (live demos strongly preferred), and your availability and expected monthly rate. Applications without portfolio links will not be considered.

Elite performers who are excellent team leaders with a positive vibe are encouraged to apply. 





What You Will Do



Operations 

You will be the operational backbone of Ice Cream Sunshine — building the systems, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and team structure that keep the business running smoothly and scaling with confidence. You will manage teams, coordinate vendors and partners, and oversee daily operations. You own project timelines and deliver early — always. Guest and customer feedback flows through you and gets translated into clear operational decisions. You set priorities around the highest impact work.

You will work directly alongside the founder— managing day to day business and personal needs so the founder stays focused on what matters most. You protect the founder's time by owning routine decisions and flagging only what truly requires owner input. You provide concise operational updates and keep priorities and timelines on track. And at the center of everything you do, you help shape and sustain a good vibes, respectful company culture that everyone on the team is proud to be part of.

$7–$9/hr USD + bonus plan

A direct, collaborative relationship with the founder — your perspective is valued and essential here

A supportive, respectful team environment where people genuinely enjoy working together

A real path to growth as Ice Cream Sunshine scales

Fun times with virtual team events
